text.completed: Return to Velan Brightoak at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.

english.title: Pelt Collection
english.objectives: Velan Brightoak at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods wants you to bring him 6 Springpaw Pelts.
english.description: The springpaw that inhabit this region are known for their high quality pelts.  We've even seen night elf scum travel to these lands just to poach them.$B$BOur skirmishes with the Amani have put a bit of a strain on our supply of gear and our rangers don't have much time to hunt for pelts anymore.  If you'd be willing to lend a hand by collecting springpaw pelts, I'd be happy to reward you with a hand-crafted piece of armor.  You'll find springpaw stalkers all around the woods north of here.
english.progress: You're back.  Did you bring the pelts?
english.completion: These will do perfectly, $n.  Take this piece of armor as a reward.  I'll be able to make more with the pelts you brought me.
english.completed: Return to Velan Brightoak at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 联盟需要铜锭！
text.objectives: 带20个铜锭给铁炉堡军事区的石眉中尉。
text.description: 嘿$C，你看起来很适合为战事贡献一点心力！我们需要所有的协助去收集一些安其拉之战需要的材料。$B$B我正在收集20个一堆的铜锭。这个目标是值得的，你要加入吗？
text.progress: 你收集好那20个铜锭了吗?
text.completion: 你成功了$G小伙子:小姑娘;!我们会将那些铜锭堆放好并立刻做成有用的战器。就是有你这样的人努力才让我觉得为联盟效力是骄傲的。做的好，士兵!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Stonebrow in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Copper Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Hey there, $c, you look fit enough to contribute to the war effort! We need all of the help that we can get here to put together the materiel needed for the Ahn'Qiraj War and it's your lucky day.$B$BI'm collecting copper bars in stacks of twenty. It's for a worthy cause, what do you say? Do you think you could help out the Alliance?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Stonebrow in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多铜锭！
text.objectives: 带20个铜锭给丹莫洛飞机场的石眉中尉。
text.description: 又回来了$C？太好了！我们需要更多你从安其拉之战取得的铜锭。你会帮我们吗？
text.progress: 又回来了$C?太好了!我们还需要大量的铜锭，为了准备安其拉之战，请尽你所能地帮我收集铜锭，这些铜锭是要用来建造蒸汽坦克跟旋翼机，$B$B我们为了安其拉战役，真的还需要更多铜锭，你愿意帮帮我们吗?
text.completion: 做的好!到处挖铜一定是个很大的冒险吧。除非你是在拍卖场买到它们的。反正，我都需要它们。你对战事的贡献会受到表扬的$C。
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Stonebrow in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Copper Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 copper bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Back again $c? Outstanding! We still need more stacks of copper bars if you can procure them for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort.  Will you help us out?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Stonebrow in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要铁锭！
text.objectives: 带20个铁锭给铁炉堡军事区的卡恩斯下士。
text.description: 嗨，$G先生:女士; 花裤子，我眼睛没花吧。避免你去冒险的时候没听到，联盟正努力为安其拉战役加紧脚步并需要铁锭。帮我带20个一堆的铁锭来。我们可以信赖你吧，$C？
text.progress: 如果你收集到那20个铁锭，我可不想发现你把它们都藏起来了!
text.completion: 嗯，嗯，多亏了你$N。你渡过难关了。我想现在我要多注意你。我不想这么说，但是谢谢你的帮忙。联盟不会忘记，我也不会。现在快离开这里去看看还有什么需要收集。
text.completed: Return to Corporal Carnes in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Well hello there, $g Mr. : Ms.; Fancypants, aren't you a sight for sore eyes. In case you hadn't heard while you were out there "adventuring", the Alliance has been gearing up for a war in Ahn'Qiraj and is in need of iron bars... a whole mess of 'em. Bring them to me in stacks of twenty. We can count on you, right, $c?
english.completed: Return to Corporal Carnes in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多铁锭！
text.objectives: 带20个铁锭给丹莫洛飞机场的卡恩斯下士。
text.description: 这么快就回来了?不要让我再重新评估对你不好的看法$C，你让我觉得很感伤。那么，你知道我们仍然没有足够的铁锭供应武器、护甲、蒸汽坦克和搜寻故障所有需要的东西。你觉得你可以在去祖尔格拉布的路上，或是你们这些孩子现在鬼混的地方带回另一批20个铁锭吗?
text.progress: 这么快就回来了?不要让我再重新评估对你不好的看法$C，你让我觉得很感伤。那么，你知道我们仍然没有足够的铁锭供应武器、护甲、蒸汽坦克和搜寻故障所有需要的东西。你觉得你可以在去祖尔格拉布的路上，或是你们这些孩子现在鬼混的地方带回另一批20个铁锭吗?
text.completion: 燃烧平原那里一定是个寒冷的天气。看这里，是$N，而且$G他:她;给我带来了一个礼物。20个铁锭!正是我一直想要的。$B$B我真的万分感谢你，$N。你是自己也是联盟的荣誉。现在离开这里去收集更多战争需要的东西吧。
text.completed: Return to Corporal Carnes in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Iron Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 iron bars to Corporal Carnes at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Back so soon? Stop making me re-evaluate my low opinion of you $c, you're making me feel all gooey inside. So, as you can tell we still don't have enough iron bars for all of the weapons, armor, steam tanks and whatnot that need building for the bug hunt. Think you have it in you to bring back another stack of twenty iron bars in between all of those trips to Zul'Gurub, or wherever it is that you kids hang out these days?
english.completed: Return to Corporal Carnes in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 战场上的绷带
text.objectives: 把30根厚符文布绷带、30根厚魔纹绷带和30根厚丝质绷带交给唤风者梅恩·长角。你还必须随身带着后勤任务简报 X才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 我们的绷带储备在最近接连不断的战事之后急剧降低。收集大量的急救物资，把它们交给塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角。
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Bandages for the Field
english.objectives: Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
english.description: Our supply of bandages in the battlefield is running dangerously low after the recent casualties we have incurred.  Obtain a batch of first-aid supplies and deliver them to Windcaller Proudhorn in Cenarion Hold.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 沙漠生存包
text.objectives: 带4个纯水之球，4个强效抗毒药剂和4个沙漠肉丸子带到希利苏斯给塞纳里奥城堡旅店的卡兰德拉斯。你还必须将后勤任务简报 I带去才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 随着新兵增援塞纳里奥城堡，如何让他们在沙漠中生存成了一个问题。缺水是基本的问题，沙漠中无数具毒的生物对没有经验的志愿兵而言是很大的威胁。收集沙漠生存工具包需要的物资并带给塞纳里奥城堡的卡兰德拉斯。
text.completed: Return to Calandrath at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Desert Survival Kits
english.objectives: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.
english.description: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert.  Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers.  Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.
english.completed: Return to Calandrath at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 暮光作战命令
text.objectives: 拿到暮光作战命令然后带给希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的指挥官玛尔利斯。
text.description: 我们的侦察兵报告暮光之锤的领袖收到了新的战斗命令。现在这个命令正被重兵把守着发送到各个暮光先知那里。拦截这封命令然后把他们带给指挥官玛尔利斯。
text.progress: 你带了什麽东西要给我吗?
text.completion: 很好。比敌人抢先一步是很重要的。这项消息可以让我们预测暮光之锤的攻击。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Twilight Battle Orders
english.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
english.description: Our scouts have reported new battle orders being issued by the Twilight's Hammer leaders.  The orders are being distributed by Twilight Prophets under heavy escort.  Intercept the orders and bring them to Commander Mar'alith.
english.progress: You've brought something for me?
english.completion: Excellent.  It's important to stay ahead of the enemy's next move.  This information will allow us to anticipate the Twilight's Hammer's attacks.
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 联盟需要瑟银锭！
text.objectives: 把20块瑟银锭交给丹莫洛飞机场的达米。
text.description: 你能主动关心联盟需要什么东西，这真是太好了。除了现在正在收集的各种物资之外，我们还需要大量的瑟银锭，我将负责这方面的收集。所有的瑟银都将用于制作各种战争必需的物资，特别是用来制造一个军团的蒸汽坦克，准备进攻希利苏斯。你能帮帮我吗，$C？
text.progress: 哦，我兄弟让你送来的货?太棒了!我今天运气真好!
text.completion: 喔，谢谢你，$C!谢谢你!这样就完成了20个，还有无法估计的数量要收集。你赢得联盟的感谢，你的努力会得到应有的奖励。等你收集更多的瑟银锭再次与我交谈吧。
text.completed: Return to Dame Twinbraid in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Thorium Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Thorium Bars to Dame Twinbraid at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: It is very kind of you to inquire about the needs that the Alliance has. In addition to all of the other collection efforts underway, we are in need of a great quantity of thorium bars, which is the task that I am in charge of. The thorium will be used in the creation of many different things for the war, foremost of which is the construction of a battalion of steam tanks to be airlifted into Silithus as soon as they are completed. Can you aid us in this endeavor, $c?
english.completed: Return to Dame Twinbraid in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多瑟银锭！
text.objectives: 把20块瑟银锭交给铁炉堡军事区的达米。
text.description: 你能主动关心联盟需要什么东西，这真是太好了。除了现在正在收集的各种物资之外，我们还需要大量的瑟银锭，我将负责这方面的收集。所有的瑟银都将用于制作各种战争必需的物资，特别是用来制造一个军团的蒸汽坦克，准备进攻希利苏斯。你能帮帮我吗，$C？
text.progress: 你能主动关心联盟需要什么东西，这真是太好了。除了现在正在收集的各种物资之外，我们还需要大量的瑟银锭，我将负责这方面的收集。所有的瑟银都将用于制作各种战争必需的物资，特别是用来制造一个军团的蒸汽坦克，准备进攻希利苏斯。你能帮帮我吗，$C？
text.completion: 很好，$C!做的很好。我会看着那些瑟银锭被放入机器并在铁匠和工程师的手上变成军队的补给。再次谢谢你，如果你有更多瑟银锭记得拿给我。
text.completed: Return to Dame Twinbraid in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Thorium Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 thorium bars to Dame Twinbraid at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: It is so good to see you again $N. I hope that you've been doing well. It's true that we are still in need of thorium bars. If you have them to spare I am collecting them for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort.
english.completed: Return to Dame Twinbraid in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 目标：亚什毒蝎
text.objectives: 击杀30只亚什毒蝎，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的指挥官玛尔利斯复命。你还必须带着作战任务简报 XII才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 这一地区猖獗的异种虫类对我们来说是个巨大的威胁。你被指派负责对亚什虫巢发动攻击，主要目标是亚什毒蝎。$B$B在你的任务完成之后，向指挥官玛尔利斯汇报。
text.progress: 你有什麽事要跟我说吗，$N?
text.completion: 干得好，$N。你在亚什虫巢攻击行动中的卓越表现已经引起了关注。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Target: Hive'Ashi Stingers
english.objectives: Kill 30 Hive'Ashi Stingers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XII in order to complete this quest.$B$B
english.description: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations.  You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Ashi where your primary target will consist of the airborne Hive'Ashi stingers.$B$BReport back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
english.progress: You wish to tell me something, $n?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Your part in the attack on Hive'Ashi has been noted.
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 目标：亚什工蝎
text.objectives: 击杀30只亚什工蝎，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的指挥官玛尔利斯复命。你还必须带着作战任务简报 III才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 这一地区猖獗的异种虫类对我们来说是个巨大的威胁。你被指派负责对亚什虫巢发动攻击，主要目标是亚什工蝎。$B$B在你的任务完成之后，向指挥官玛尔利斯汇报。
text.progress: 你有事要告诉我，$C。
text.completion: 做的好，$N。少了他们的工蠍，异种蠍就很难修补他们虫巢结构所受的伤害。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Target: Hive'Ashi Workers
english.objectives: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
english.description: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations.  You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Ashi where your primary target will consist of Hive'Ashi workers.$B$BReport back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
english.progress: You have something to tell me, $c?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Without their workers, the silithid will have a hard time repairing any damage inflicted to their hive's structure.
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 联盟需要荆棘藻！
text.objectives: 把20棵荆棘藻交给丹莫罗飞机场的列兵德拉里格。
text.description: 那么$C，我是否告诉过你荆棘藻的所有用处？有没有说过？哦，好吧……不管怎么样，我们需要很多荆棘藻，我说很多的意思就是非常非常多！你可以帮帮我吗？我知道这意味着你无法用它来制作许多你需要的东西，但是我们是在为了正义的事业而努力！
text.progress: 这不是真的!我从来没有将这些堆积物上面的荆棘藻去除过。有人可能会认为它几乎就是经济利义下有效的万灵丹。*咳咳*你不会正好有我们先前谈的荆棘藻吧?
text.completion: 万岁!又少了20个。你是最棒的。来看看，我要怎么奖励你?首先我要将你的名字写在我的名单中然后再将它传给别人，让大家都知道你的贡献。再次的感谢你$C!
text.completed: Return to Private Draxlegauge in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: So, $c, did I already tell you about all of the fabulous uses stranglekelp has? I did? Oh well... in any case we need a lot of it, and when I say a lot, I mean A LOT! Do you think that you could help us out? I know that it means going without all of those wonderful things that you can make with it, but it's for a good cause!
english.completed: Return to Private Draxlegauge in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多荆棘藻！
text.objectives: 带20个荆棘藻给丹莫洛飞机场的士兵德拉里格。
text.description: 又见面了…有什么事？啊，对了，$N！来看看我是否需要更多的荆棘藻吗？嗯，今天真是你的幸运日，因为这个重要问题的答案是肯定的“是”！你可以再收集20个来吗？
text.completed: Return to Private Draxlegauge in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Stranglekelp!
english.objectives: Bring 20 stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Well hello again there... what was it? Ah yes, $N! Come to see if I still need more stranglekelp have you? Well, it's your lucky day, because the answer to that very important question is a very affirmative YES! Think you could gather up twenty more?
english.completed: Return to Private Draxlegauge in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要紫莲花！
text.objectives: 带20朵紫莲花给铁炉堡军事区的夜歌大师。
text.description: $C，紫莲花是一种有很多功用的花。我现在受联盟委托负责保存这些收集到的草药并确保他们有足够的紫莲花可供使用。$B$B我希望你去世界走走并带回这些花给我。你能办到吗？
text.progress: 你有我要的紫莲花草药了吗?
text.completion: 我们非常感谢你的贡献，$C。只有大家同心协力才能将无情的异种发展和所有驱使他们的力量击退。就连部落也都在收集他们自己的紫莲花。如果你收集得够多，请带到这里给我。
text.completed: Return to Master Nightsong in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Purple Lotus!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Master Nightsong at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: $C, the purple lotus is a flower with a plentitude of uses. I am here at the request of the Alliance as an authority on those applications, to preserve the herbs collected and to ensure that their war effort acquires enough purple lotus to sustain whatever function they plan for it.$B$BI would like for you to travel out into the world and return to me with some of these flowers. Is that something that you can do?
english.completed: Return to Master Nightsong in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多紫莲花！
text.objectives: 把20朵紫莲花交给铁炉堡军事区的艾文·夜歌。
text.description: $C，紫莲花是一种非常有用的植物。我在这里作为联盟的官员收集紫莲花，我要负责监督整个收集过程，并保证在战时有足够的紫莲花储量可供使用。我希望你可以到世界各地帮我带回一些紫莲花。你可以做到吗？
text.completed: Return to Master Nightsong in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Purple Lotus!
english.objectives: Bring 20 purple lotus to Master Nightsong at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Welcome back $c. Our collection grows, but even now we have a need for additional purple lotus. If it is still within your power to gather more of the herb, I entreat you to do so and return them to me here.
english.completed: Return to Master Nightsong in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 战地任务
text.objectives: 向佐拉虫巢外的铁炉堡军团报到，从布莱卡维尔上尉那里拿到签过字的战地任务文件，把它交给希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者卡尔东。$B$B注意：给铁炉堡军团的士兵治疗或者施放增益法术会打开你的PvP标志。
text.description: 你好，$N。在我为你布置更重要的任务之前，你需要首先完成一些常规的战地任务。$B$B你可以在佐拉虫穴外找到布莱卡维尔上尉的部队。$B$B向他或者他的副官珍妮拉·钢锤报到，然后回到我这里来。那时我将会给你下达进一步的指令。$B$B哦，别忘了离奥格瑞玛军团远一些。由于这两股势力之间的互相仇视，我们被迫把他们分开来。
text.progress: 你可以在佐拉虫巢外找到布莱卡维尔上尉的军队。和他的中尉，珍妮拉·钢锤谈谈，如果你能找到他的话。
text.completion: 很好，$N。我已准备了一系列最适合你的技能的任务。$B$B有你和像你这样的人继续努力，我们的敌人很快就会被击败了!$B$B要取得新的任务简报，回去找布莱卡维尔上尉。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Field Duty
english.objectives: Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora.  Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.$B$BNote: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Ironforge Brigade will flag you for PvP.
english.description: Greetings, $N.  Before I assign you to more involved tasks in the war, you'll need to do your share of field duty.  $B$BYou will find Captain Blackanvil's Ironforge Brigade outside Hive'Zora.$B$BReport to him or his lieutenant, Janela Stouthammer and come back to me.  I shall have a more advanced assignment for you ready.$B$BOh and please do us a favor and stay away from the Orgrimmar Legion.  We've been forced to keep the two forces well apart from one another due to mutual animosity.
english.progress: You'll find Captain Blackanvil's force stationed outside Hive'Zora.  Talk to his lieutenant, Janela Stouthammer, if you can't find him.
english.completion: Very well, $n.  I've prepared a set of tasks that should make optimal use of your skills. With the continued efforts of you and people like you, our enemy will soon be vanquished once and for all! Should you require a new mission briefing, return to Captain Blackanvil.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 战地任务文件
text.progress: 战地任务报告?这是什麽狗屁规矩啊，$N?
text.completion: 若在古老时代，我会用生物的血在你前额注记你的功劳。索尔坚持我们要服从德鲁伊的命令。$B$B把这些文件拿回到塞纳里奥城堡。我确信他们有适合的工作要交付於你。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Blackanvil in Silithus.

english.title: Field Duty Papers
english.completion: Aye, I suppose that little skirmish will pass as field duty nowadays.  Take these back to Cenarion Hold, I'm sure they'll have a cushy job ready for you. Off you go!
english.completed: Return to Captain Blackanvil in Silithus.

text.title: 联盟需要阿尔萨斯之泪！
text.objectives: 带20份阿萨斯之泪给铁炉堡军事区的士官长戈麦恩。
text.description: 我会简洁的切入重点，$C。联盟需要为安其拉之战收集大量的阿萨斯之泪。不要问我做什么用；我也不在乎它的用途。但我要你去收集越多草药越好并将它们带回来给我。你愿意这么做吗？
text.progress: 那是什么?大声的说出来，$C!你拿到我要的阿萨斯之泪吗?
text.completion: 做的好，$C。我必需说我真的有点惊讶。让我把它们装进木箱里并标上你的名字，然后再来谈谈我是否需要更多那些植物。
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Major Germaine in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Arthas' Tears!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: I'll keep it simple and to the point, $c. The Alliance needs to collect a large quantity of Arthas' Tears for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Don't ask me what for; I'm just following orders. But I'd like you to gather up as many of the herbs as you can and bring them back to me here. Are you willing to do that?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Major Germaine in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多阿尔萨斯之泪！
text.objectives: 把20棵阿尔萨斯之泪交给铁炉堡军事区的士官长戈麦恩。
text.description: 我会简要地告诉你重点，$C。联盟需要大量的阿尔萨斯之泪来准备安其拉战争。不要问我它们是用来做什么的，我并不关心这个。但是我需要你收集尽可能多地这种草药，并把它们交给我。你愿意这样做吗？
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Major Germaine in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Arthas' Tears!
english.objectives: Bring 20 arthas' tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Ok, so it looks like I still need more Arthas' Tears. I would imagine that you will be able to find them in the general location that you gathered them up for me last time. The quicker we get these, the faster we can start up the offensive against the forces at Ahn'Qiraj.$B$BYou gonna help us out again $c?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Major Germaine in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要轻皮！
text.objectives: 把10块轻皮交给丹莫罗飞机场的波尼·碎石。
text.description: 我们家族历代都是著名的剥皮匠，$C。这就是联盟要求我们为了安其拉之战而收集轻皮的原因。我在这里的工作是确保皮革经过正确的处理，准备投入使用。但是我们需要你的帮助。$B$B因为我不得不留在这里，所以我需要你去帮忙收集皮革，然后把它们交给我。你觉得怎么样，$G小伙子:小姑娘;，你会帮我吗？
text.progress: $C，我希望你带来了你所允诺的轻皮。
text.completion: 我敢说联盟一定会因为你这里的皮革感到很高兴，$C。我不会浪费任何一块皮革。谢谢你，记得在我清点好它们的时候回来找我，看看我是否需要更多的皮革。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bonnie Stoneflayer in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: We Stoneflayers have a long history of being skinners, $c. That's why the Alliance has asked my family to help out with the collection of light leather for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm here to see to it that the leather is tanned correctly for whatever they want to put it to use for. But we need your help.$B$BSince I have to be here doing that, I need you to go out and collect the skins, returning them to me here. What do you say, $g lad : lass;, will you give it a go?
english.completed: Return to Bonnie Stoneflayer in Dun Morogh.

text.title: The Alliance Needs More Light Leather!
text.objectives: 带10张轻皮给丹莫洛飞机场的波尼•碎石。
text.description: 很高兴再见到你，$N。显然我们需要更多轻皮来制作各种战争要用的东西。如果你能再帮我带来10张轻皮就太完美了。
text.progress: 很高兴再见到你，$N。显然我们需要更多轻皮来制作各种战争要用的东西。如果你能再帮我带来10张轻皮就太完美了。
text.completion: 谢谢你慷慨的捐献，$N。我会让相关人士知道你的名字，这样高权者就会知道你为战争做的努力。看来我们好像永远都需要更多的轻皮。快点回来找我。
text.completed: Return to Bonnie Stoneflayer in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Light Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 light leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Good to see you again $N. It does appear that we need more light leather for the creation of the various war materiel. If you could bring me a stack of ten that would be just perfect.
english.completed: Return to Bonnie Stoneflayer in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要中皮!
text.objectives: 带10张中皮给铁炉堡军事区的士兵波特。
text.description: 是的$G 先生 : 女士;，我被指派收集并追踪所有为战事收集的中皮。如果你有收集中皮的方法，不管是那种来源，都请将它们带来给我。我会很感激你的帮忙。
text.progress: 是的$G先生:女士;，我记得你。你带来的是中皮吗?
text.completion: 哇!看来你是自愿来帮忙的。非常感谢你的捐献。我会把它们都装箱并点清。你真知道怎麽讨人开心。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Private Porter in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Medium Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 Medium Leather to Private Porter at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Yes $g sir : ma'am;, I have been charged with collecting and tracking all of the medium leather gathered for the war effort. If you have the wherewithal to gather medium leather, from whatever source, then please bring them to me here. I sure would appreciate a hand with this if you can spare the time.
english.completed: Return to Private Porter in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多中皮！
text.objectives: 带10张中皮给丹莫洛飞机场的士兵波特。
text.description: 是的$G 先生 : 女士;，看来目前我们已经收集了$2063w张中皮。我知道这个数量很庞大，但如果你愿意，我可以藉由你的帮忙让我的配额减少一点。
text.progress: 是的$G先生:女士;，看来当前我们已经收集了很多中皮。但我们需要更多的中皮。我可以向你保证这很好用;一块也不要浪费。我知道这个数量很庞大，但如果你愿意，我可以藉由你的帮忙让我的配额减少一点。
text.completion: 天啊，你真的带了很多中皮来$G先生:女士;!我会将你的名字和功绩列在清单上。有你的帮忙我们很快就能将中皮收集好了!$B$B谢谢，$N!
text.completed: Return to Private Porter in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Medium Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 medium leather to Private Porter at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Yes $g sir : ma'am;, looks like we've collected $2063w pieces of medium leather to date. I know it's a lot to ask, but if you're still willing, I could use your help in attempting to put a dent in the rest of my quota.
english.completed: Return to Private Porter in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要厚皮!
text.objectives: 带10张厚皮给铁炉堡军事区的玛塔·钢轴。
text.description: 喔，天啊，这还真棒!$C，安其拉之战一触即发，而我被指派负责收集所有的重皮。我们会用它制作一大堆东西，但首先我们必须放集一大堆重皮。而且我指的是真的一大堆!那就是你要做的事。$B$B所以，你觉得你能帮我带回来一堆优质、肥厚的重皮吗?可以吗，可以吗?!
text.progress: 你包包里的东西是重皮吗，$C?是吗?我等不及你把它们交给我了!大家都会很满意我们的，你说是吗?
text.completion: 喔，我就知道你可以做到，$C，我就知道!我会尽快把这些东西交到到正确的人手里。现在，来看看这里。嗯，看来我们的货物进展的不错。你应该在我清点好之後再回来看我需不需要更多的重皮。因为如果我们需要的话，你就是我要找的助手!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Marta Finespindle in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Marta Finespindle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Oh boy, this is going to be great! $C, the Ahn'Qiraj war effort is in full swing, and I've been put in charge of keeping track of all of the thick leather that comes in. We'll make tons of things with it, but first we need to get a ton of it. And I mean that literally! That's where you come in.$B$BSo, do you think you can go out there and bring me back a nice, fat stack of thick leather? Do yah, do yah?!
english.completed: Return to Marta Finespindle in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多厚皮！
text.objectives: 带10张厚皮给丹莫洛飞机场的玛塔·钢轴。
text.description: 没错，存货仍然不够。$N，我们仍未达到理想的$2071w张重皮。想想我们能用重皮做的所有东西！各种护甲和武器。蒸气坦克的零件和步枪瞄准器！工程学护目镜，而且如果到最后我们还有剩下，可以把它们交给部落的齐柏林飞艇！$B$B你会为我带更多的重皮回来吗？
text.progress: 没错，存货仍然不够。$N，我们仍未达到理想的目标。想想我们能用重皮做的所有东西!各种护甲和武器。蒸汽坦克的零件和步枪瞄准器!工程学护目镜，而且如果到最后我们还有剩下，可以把它们交给部落的齐柏林飞艇!$B$B你会为我带更多的重皮回来吗?
text.completion: 你又办到了!你能踏出这里收集所有的东西真是太神奇了，然后再把它们带回来交给我。我告诉你，如果他们知道你帮了多大的忙，你走到街上就一定会有人跟你要签名。$B$B再次谢谢你慷慨的捐献重皮，$N。
text.completed: Return to Marta Finespindle in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Thick Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 thick leather to Marta Finespindle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Yep, the stack's still not high enough. $N, we still haven't reached our goal of $2071w thick leather. Just think of all the things that we can make with all of that leather! All kinds of armor and weapons. Stuff for inside the steam tanks and rifle scopes! Engineering goggles, and I bet if it ends up that we collect too much we could give the rest to the Horde for their zeppelins!$B$BYou gonna bring me back some more thick leather?
english.completed: Return to Marta Finespindle in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要亚麻绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷亚麻绷带交给铁炉堡军事区的哨兵塞尔瓦·银空。
text.description: 安其拉的战争将会持续很长时间，并且会非常残酷。显然联盟寻求你们这些冒险者的帮助是很明智的选择，我们需要收集足够的资源来赢得这场战争。$B$B我在这里收集战争所需要的亚麻绷带，希望你可以帮助我们达成目标。现在一切物资都很紧缺，但是至少亚麻绷带还是比较容易制作的。你愿意帮助我们吗，$C？
text.progress: 你有我要的20个亚麻布绷带了吗，$C?
text.completion: 很多士兵都会因为你的捐献而受惠，$C。我会亲自确定联盟的人都知道你的努力。先让我储存好这些绷带并更新我的数量，然后你要再回来看看我是否还需要更多。$B$B愿伊露恩之光照耀着你，$R!
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Silversky in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Linen Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: The war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to be long and bloody. It is a very wise thing that the Alliance is doing by enlisting the aid of you, and those like you, to build up the materiel necessary before plunging headlong into conflict.$B$BI have been asked to head up the collection of linen bandages for the war, and I am hoping that you are going to assist me in amassing as many as we need. It is no light matter, but at least the linen bandages are the least difficult to create. Are you with us, $c?
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Silversky in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多亚麻绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷亚麻绷带交给丹莫罗飞机场的哨兵塞尔瓦·银空。
text.description: 我非常惊奇有那么多无私的人将私欲抛于一旁。$C，我还需要收集更多的亚麻绷带，直到完成我的指标。你是否可以再帮我收集一些亚麻绷带呢？
text.progress: 我非常惊奇有那么多无私的人将私欲抛于一旁。$C，我还需要收集更多的亚麻绷带，直到完成我的指标。你是否可以再帮我收集一些亚麻绷带呢？
text.completion: 你会受到表扬，$N。当其它人会在我们的战争立足点上占经济的便宜来填满他们的荷包时，你却对联盟牺牲奉献，而且对整个艾泽拉斯而言你是第一个这么做的人。$B$B愿伊露恩的祝福永远跟随你!
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Silversky in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 linen bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Ever am I amazed by the selflessness exhibited when so many would instead turn to selfishness instead. $C, I am still in need of a number of linen bandages before my assignment here is fulfilled. Will you aid me once more in the collection of those bandages?
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Silversky in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 往日的回忆
text.objectives: 了解所以可以的过去的事情，然后和塔纳利斯时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯谈谈。
text.description: 当你恢复镇静并重新汇集目光的时候，你发现有些东西从水晶之内往外瞪着。通过进一步的观察，你所看到的是过去……一段记忆……很久之前就遗忘的记忆。
text.completion: 在鹿盔的背叛之後，我收集了流沙之地权杖碎片并回到这里。我尽了所有力气来保护权杖，不让想用它来伤害世界的人使用它－因此才有龙族军团的攻击。$B$B在四只巨龙之间分裂的权杖实在不太可能重整那些蓄意制造的混乱……至少我是这样想的。我真是个笨蛋。到现在我还是被那受诅咒的思想困扰着。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

english.title: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
english.objectives: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.$B$B
english.description: As you regain your composure and focus your gaze, you notice that something stirs within the crystal. Upon closer inspection, you realize that you are looking into the past... a memory... long forgotten.
english.completion: After Staghelm's betrayal, I gathered the shattered pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and returned here. I had every intention of protecting the scepter from those that would seek to use it to cause harm to our world - thus was born the charge of the Dragonflights. A scepter divided amongst the four mighty Aspects would prove to be nearly impossible to restore for those willfully seeking chaos... or so I thought. What a fool I was. Even now I am hunted by that cursed flight.
english.end: The War of the Shifting Sands
english.completed: Return to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

text.title: 联盟需要丝质绷带！
text.objectives: 带20个丝质绷带给铁炉堡军事区的护士斯通菲尔德。
text.description: 随着安其拉之战逼近，我们一定要做好所有准备让士兵们无后患之忧。我们就在这里准备。我的工作被指派为收集足够的丝质绷带。$B$B你觉得你能帮我吗，$C？
text.progress: 我需要那些外套和头罩，另外还需要一株野葡萄，然後我就会把蛮皮盔帽的制作方法告诉你。$B$B防护头部的装备是冒险者们垂涎已久的，无论是简单的头带还是一顶密闭的盔帽，无论其外观如何，制造有价值的头部装备的道理是恒久不变的。
text.completion: 你提供的装备完美地符合我的要求，$N。我就是需要像你这样有才干的制皮师。$B$B你靠自己的能力赢得了蛮皮头盔的制作方法。现在我将这个图样送给你，希望你能从中受益。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nurse Stonefield in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough silk bandages.$B$BDo you think you can help me out, $c?
english.completed: Return to Nurse Stonefield in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多丝质绷带！
text.objectives: 带20个丝质绷带给丹莫洛飞机场的护士斯通菲尔德。
text.description: 你能再次帮我真是太好了，$C。看来我们已经收集了$2082w个丝质绷带，所以我们需要更多绷带。
text.progress: 你能再次提供我协助真是太好了，$C。看来我们已经收集了一堆丝质绷带，不过我们还需要更多。$N，你可以再想办法弄另一捆绷带拿来给我吗?联盟和我都会非常感激的。
text.completion: 你真是个无私的人。非常谢谢你对战争的贡献。只有像你这样的人才能让安其拉的成功和失败有所区别。我只希望这些东西已经足够。$B$B，再次感谢，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nurse Stonefield in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Silk Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 silk bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: It is very kind of you to offer to help me again $c. It looks like we've collected $2082w silk bandages, so we'll need more.
english.completed: Return to Nurse Stonefield in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要符文布绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷符文布绷带交给铁炉堡军事区的守护者莫沙·月影。
text.description: 关于战争的走向，你可以随意评说，$C，但是现在这场战争已经箭在弦上。看看你周围的朋友和家人，问问你自己，如果战争真的爆发，你会为此做些什么，你周围的人会一定会尽其所能地努力生存下来。$B$B现在，我在这里收集符文布绷带。你愿意捐赠一些吗？
text.progress: 日子一天天过去，我们也继续向前走。$C，你有那些符文布绷带了吗?
text.completion: 你会因为这次任务的坚毅不拔受到表扬的，$C。我要把这些绷带收好，然后再和你谈谈有关收集更多符文布绷带的可能性。
text.completed: Return to Keeper Moonshade in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Runecloth Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Argue the merits of the war if you will, $c, but it has already been set in motion. Look around you at your family and friends, and then ask yourself what it is that you can do to see to it that if they are involved, they will have every advantage to survive the conflagration.$B$BTo that end, I am collecting runecloth bandages here from whatever source. Would you like to make a donation?
english.completed: Return to Keeper Moonshade in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多符文布绷带！
text.objectives: 带20个符文布绷带给丹莫洛飞机场的守护者月影。
text.description: 又是讨论紧急事件的时候了，$C。我再次感谢你之前所作的努力；不是每个人都能如此无私奉献。但是我们仍然很多事要完成。$B$B$N，你可以再去收集符文布绷带并拿回来这里给我吗？
text.progress: 又是讨论紧急事件的时候了，$C。我再次感谢你之前所作的努力;不是每个人都能如此无私奉献。但是我们仍然很多事要完成。$B$B$N，你可以再去收集符文布绷带并拿回来这里给我吗?
text.completion: 这是我们一起走过的美好回忆，$N。你是个杰出的工作伙伴。我要再次感谢你的努力，联盟也很感激你。早点回来和我聊聊。
text.completed: Return to Keeper Moonshade in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 runecloth bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: So it is that we come to discuss pressing matters yet again $c. Once more I thank you for your previous efforts; it is not everyone who would give so selflessly. But there is still more work to do.$B$B$N, will you once more collect runecloth bandages and return them to me here?
english.completed: Return to Keeper Moonshade in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要彩鳍鱼！
text.objectives: 把20条彩鳍鱼交给丹莫罗飞机场的美食家斯里克。
text.description: 你好，朋友！你不认为士兵也和别人一样需要吃饭吗？你当然会赞同这一点。我110%地同意你的看法！很高兴我们达成了一致。现在我要你做的就是去钓很多很多新鲜的彩鳍鱼，然后把它们烧好，带到我这里来。嗯，我仿佛已经可以尝到它们了……
text.progress: 我敢打赌你已经带回我们之前讨论的彩鳍鱼了，对吧?
text.completion: 两条给联盟，一条给我，两条给联盟，一条给我。嘿，鱼贩，做的好。我可以预见你将要成为团体里真正的荣耀了。对我而言我们可能还需要那种鱼。你何不出去再弄些鱼回来呢。我已经听见我肚子咕噜噜叫了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Slicky Gastronome in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Rainbow Fin Albacore!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Hey there, friend! If I were to say to you, 'Don't you think that soldiers should have food to eat like anyone else?', you would of course reply, 'yes'. I agree with you 110%! I'm glad we're in accord. All I need for you to do is to head out there, fish up a whole bunch of raw rainbow fin albacore, and then cook it all up and bring it back to me right here. Mmm, mmm, I can taste it already.
english.completed: Return to Slicky Gastronome in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多彩鳍鱼！
text.objectives: 把20条彩鳍鱼交给铁炉堡军事区的美食家斯里克。
text.description: 你好，朋友！你不认为士兵也和别人一样需要吃饭吗？你当然会赞同这一点。我110%地同意你的看法！很高兴我们达成了一致。现在我要你做的就是去钓很多很多新鲜的彩鳍鱼，然后把它们烧好，带到我这里来。嗯，我仿佛已经可以尝到它们了……
text.progress: 你好，朋友！你不认为士兵也和别人一样需要吃饭吗？你当然会赞同这一点。我110%地同意你的看法！很高兴我们达成了一致。现在我要你做的就是去钓很多很多新鲜的彩鳍鱼，然后把它们烧好，带到我这里来。嗯，我仿佛已经可以尝到它们了……
text.completion: 我知道你把它放在你的包包里。你看起来就像是知道$G他:她;喜欢什麽的样子。尤其是你喜欢讨好我和那些权势。而且你成功了，我保证。$B$B哈哈，好了，我先把这些鱼收好，然後你和我就能谈谈关於收集另外20条鱼的事了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Slicky Gastronome in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!
english.objectives: Bring 20 rainbow fin albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: What! You again? Well I'll be a monkey's uncle... except that I'm a gnome. Slicky Gastronome to be precise! So you're back to help out again eh? Well, I can't say as I blame you. Don't you just love the smell of all of that food? <drool>$B$BEnough loitering! Get out there and bring me back more rainbow fin albacore!
english.completed: Return to Slicky Gastronome in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要烤迅猛龙肉！
text.objectives: 把20块烤迅猛龙肉交给铁炉堡军事区的萨拉·塞维斯。
text.description: 嘿，最近过得怎么样啊，$C？我看你好像有兴趣帮即将开始的安其拉战争收集食品物资。我爸爸觉得我来这里帮忙是一个学习的好方法。这可是个大错误，我根本不喜欢吃肉。不管怎么样，如果你愿意的话，请带给我大量的烤迅猛龙肉。显然这是所有士兵都想要的美食。
text.progress: 你拿到所有的烤迅猛龙肉了吗?
text.completion: 天啊，真棒。谢谢你带给我这些烤肉，$C。我先把它们堆放在这。我相信会有人看好它的。我猜如果你有空的话会带更多肉给我吧?
text.completed: Return to Sarah Sadwhistle in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Roast Raptor!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Roast Raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: Oh, how's it going, $c? I see that you're interested in maybe gathering up food for the coming war at Ahn'Qiraj? Somehow my dad thought that it would be a good learning experience for me if I were to volunteer to help out here. Big mistake. I don't even like to eat meat.$B$BAnyway, if you feel like it, you could bring me back a lot of roast raptor. Apparently that's what all of the soldiers are going to want.
english.completed: Return to Sarah Sadwhistle in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多烤迅猛龙肉！
text.objectives: 把20块烤迅猛龙肉交给铁炉堡军事区的萨拉·塞维斯。
text.description: 嘿，最近过得怎么样啊，$C？我看你好像有兴趣帮即将开始的安其拉战争收集食品物资。我爸爸觉得我来这里帮忙是一个学习的好方法。这可是个大错误，我根本不喜欢吃肉。不管怎么样，如果你愿意的话，请带给我大量的烤迅猛龙肉。显然这是所有士兵都想要的美食。
text.completed: Return to Sarah Sadwhistle in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Roast Raptor!
english.objectives: Bring 20 roast raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Hi again $c. I can tell you're very excited about all of this. So I suppose you want to bring me another twenty roast raptor. Great. Well you do that. I guess I'll see you when you get back.
english.completed: Return to Sarah Sadwhistle in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要斑点黄尾鱼！
text.objectives: 把20条斑点黄尾鱼交给铁炉堡军事区的女猎手蕾尔·急流。
text.description: 虽然看起来烧鱼算不上什么英雄事迹，但是绝对不要低估战前准备的价值，年轻的战士。士兵和其他人一样需要吃饭，我们在这里要准备的可是安其拉战争开始后所必需的东西。为此，我在这里收集斑点黄尾鱼，一种适合于存储并且可以用于多种菜肴的物资。另外它也没有其它咸水鱼的那种难闻的味道。你愿意帮助我吗？
text.progress: 我有信心你很快就会带着我们讨论的斑点黄尾鱼回来。
text.completion: 谢谢你的礼物，$C，还有你迅速的动作。我会让大家都知道你今天所做的事。先让我把这些鱼储存起来，然后如果你愿意，我们可以讨论第二次的渔获量。
text.completed: Return to Huntress Swiftriver in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
english.description: It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young $c. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.$B$BAccordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
english.completed: Return to Huntress Swiftriver in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要更多斑点黄尾鱼！
text.objectives: 带20条斑点黄尾鱼给丹莫洛飞机场的女猎手蕾尔·急流。
text.description: 如果你愿意我想派你再去捕一批斑点黄尾鱼，$N。我想你有了第一次的经验，这次捕鱼一定会更快更容易。你愿意吗？
text.progress: 如果你愿意我想派你再去捕一批斑点黄尾鱼，$N。我想你有了第一次的经验，这次捕鱼一定会更快更容易。你愿意吗？
text.completion: 你真是联盟的一份子，$N。你的努力不会被忽略或不被赏识。也谢谢你把鱼都煮好。我会将它们存放好，然后更新我的存量。每个人都给我们这么多就能更接近目标。
text.completed: Return to Huntress Swiftriver in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
english.objectives: Bring 20 spotted yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: If you're still willing I'd like to send you back out to bring in another haul of spotted yellowtail, $N. I'd imagine with the expertise you gained the first time out that this catch should be much faster and easier. Are you game?
english.completed: Return to Huntress Swiftriver in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 联盟需要熔火之石！
text.objectives: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
text.description: $C, I need your help. In the Molten Core there are these stones, singed Corestones to be precise, that we need to harvest for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm told that our blacksmiths and engineers can put them to good use, so that's where you come in. I need you to go into the Molten Core and gather up as many of these corestones as you can. Of course, you'll want to talk thirty-nine of your closest friends along with you.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stronghammer at Southfury River in Azshara.

english.title: The Alliance Needs Singed Corestones!
english.objectives: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: $C, I need your help. In the Molten Core there are these stones, singed Corestones to be precise, that we need to harvest for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm told that our blacksmiths and engineers can put them to good use, so that's where you come in. I need you to go into the Molten Core and gather up as many of these corestones as you can. Of course, you'll want to talk thirty-nine of your closest friends along with you.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stronghammer at Southfury River in Azshara.

text.title: The Alliance Needs More Singed Corestones!
text.objectives: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
text.description: Thank you for returning $N. If you and your friends still have it in you, I need you to return to the Molten Core and continue your singed corestone collection efforts. What do you say?
text.completed: Return to Commander Stronghammer in Durotar.

english.title: The Alliance Needs More Singed Corestones!
english.objectives: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
english.description: Thank you for returning $N. If you and your friends still have it in you, I need you to return to the Molten Core and continue your singed corestone collection efforts. What do you say?
english.completed: Return to Commander Stronghammer in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要铜锭！
text.objectives: 把20块铜锭交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的矿工克罗威尔。
text.description: 很高兴你来帮助我们。并不是所有人都能搞清楚我所需要的东西是什么，所以我要确保你不犯错误。我需要的是铜锭，不是铜矿石。我们没有时间自己进行熔炼，希望你可以帮助我们。你可以办到吧，$C？
text.progress: 我希望你带来的是20个铜锭，$C。
text.completion: 这些铜锭很好，谢谢你没有打亮它们。要将它们熔解做成战争要用的东西时，不需要把它们弄得那麽漂亮。我会把它们堆放好，也会确定你的名字有被记下。如果你有兴趣帮我另外带20个的话再来和我谈谈。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Copper Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: So glad that you've decided to help out here. Not everyone would, so I need to make sure you understand what it is that I need. Copper bars, not copper ore. We don't have the time or people to do all of the smelting ourselves, so if you would be so kind as to take care of that, your efforts will be duly noted. Is that something that you can handle, $c?
english.completed: Return to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多铜锭！
text.objectives: 带20个铜锭给杜洛塔的矿工克罗威尔。
text.description: 这么快就回来了？你很快就会成为一个真正的矿工了，$C。那么，你已经知道怎么钻孔了；我需要你出去帮我挖掘一堆铜矿，熔解它们做成铜锭再带回来给我。我知道你能办到，问题是，你愿意吗？
text.progress: 这么快就回来了？你很快就会成为一个真正的矿工了，$C。那么，你已经知道怎么钻孔了；我需要你出去帮我挖掘一堆铜矿，熔解它们做成铜锭再带回来给我。我知道你能办到，问题是，你愿意吗？
text.completion: 你已向我证明了你自己，$C。我会让部落的人都知道你的名字。不过现在，我需要将这些铜锭弄上货板并清点。如果你还有意愿，我希望能藉助你的力量收集更多。
text.completed: Return to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 copper bars to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.
english.description: Back so soon? You'll be a real miner in no time $c. So, you already know the drill; I need you to go out, mine up a mess of copper ore, smelt it into bars and bring it back to me here. I know that's something you're capable of, the question is, are you willing?
english.completed: Return to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.

text.title: 佐拉虫巢侦查报告
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀灰烬公爵，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那个被称作灰烬公爵的元素领主将要策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他引诱出来，然后击杀他。
text.progress: 你会在佐拉虫巢里找到塞纳里奥斥候艾泽奈尔。快，$N!时间就是金钱。
text.completion: 你的努力获得很大的赞赏，$N。我要立刻察看这些侦察报告，去接你的下一个任务吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Hive'Zora Scout Report
english.objectives: Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
english.description: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence.  Scout Azenel has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Zora for several days now.  Find her and obtain a written report.  We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, $N.
english.progress: You'll find Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora.  Hurry, $n!  Time is of the essence.
english.completion: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, $n.  I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 苍白圣殿骑士
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀深渊公爵，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那个被称深渊公爵的元素领主将要策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他引诱出来，然后击杀他。
text.progress: 你的任务完成了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。这是你的下一个任务。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Hoary Templar
english.objectives: Summon and slay a Hoary Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus.  With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.$B$BFind a way to summon and destroy a Hoary Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.$B$B
english.progress: Is your task done yet, $n?
english.completion: Good job, $n.  Here's your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 土色圣殿骑士
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀碎石公爵，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那个被称作碎石公爵的元素领主将要策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他引诱出来，然后击杀他。
text.progress: 你的任务完成了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。这是你的下一个任务。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Earthen Templar
english.objectives: Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus.  With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.$B$BFind a way to summon and destroy an Earthen Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
english.progress: Is your task done yet, $n?
english.completion: Good job, $n.  Here's your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 赤红圣殿骑士
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀微风公爵，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那个被称作微风公爵的元素领主将要策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他引诱出来，然后击杀他。
text.progress: 你的任务完成了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。这是你的下一个任务。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Crimson Templar
english.objectives: Summon and slay a Crimson Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus.  With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.$B$BFind a way to summon and destroy a Crimson Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
english.progress: Is your task done yet, $n?
english.completion: Good job, $n.  Here's your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 圣殿骑士
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀四个深渊圣殿骑士，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象中的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那些被称作深渊圣殿骑士的元素领主们可能正在策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他们引诱出来，然后击杀他们。
text.progress: 你的任务完成了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你为我们完成了一项伟大的任务，$N。你消除了对我们而言相当严重的威胁。在些表达我深深的谢意。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: The Four Dukes
english.objectives: Find a way to summon and slay the Duke of Cynders, the Duke of Fathoms, the Duke of Zephyrs and the Duke of Shards and report back to Commander Mar'alith in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The links between the Twilight's Hammer and the Abyssal Council are proving to be more important than we had expected.$B$BWe believe the elemental nobles known as the Abyssal Dukes are one of the primary force organizing the Twilight's Hammer cultists.  Find a way to lure the four Abyssal Dukes into our plane of existence and destroy them!$B$BYour dedication and prowess in past assignments have led us to choose you for this particular assignment.  We are certain you will succeed in this endeavor.
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 目标：佐拉雌蝎
text.objectives: 击杀30只佐拉雌蝎，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的指挥官玛尔利斯复命。你还必须带着作战任务简报 V才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 我们需要援军进攻佐拉虫巢。你的主要目标是那些佐拉雌蝎，当你的任务完成之后就去向指挥官玛尔利斯报告。
text.progress: 你有事要告诉我，$C。
text.completion: 做的好，$N。你是个有价值的盟友。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Target: Hive'Zora Hive Sisters
english.objectives: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Hive Sisters and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Combat Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.
english.description: Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora.  You have been selected to target Hive'Zora hive sisters.  Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
english.progress: You have something to tell me, $c?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  You're a worthy ally.
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 卫兵的靴子
text.objectives: 将3双精制秘银战靴带到希利苏斯给塞纳里奥城堡的守卫队长维斯·库鲁兹。你还必须将后勤任务简报 II带去才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 塞纳里奥城堡守卫的坐骑军师缺少精制秘银战靴。取得一批战靴并立即送给塞纳里奥城堡的维斯·库鲁兹队长。
text.completed: Return to Vish Kozus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Boots for the Guard
english.objectives: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The mounted division of the Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of ornate mithril boots.  Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
english.completed: Return to Vish Kozus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 卫兵的磨刀石
text.objectives: 把磨刀石交给希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的维斯·库鲁兹。
text.description: 塞纳里奥要塞的卫兵急需磨刀石。去收集足够的磨刀石，然后立即把它们交给塞纳里奥要塞的维斯·库鲁兹队长。
text.progress: You have something for me?
text.completion: Excellent.  We were in need of these, $n.  Good work.
text.completed: Return to Vish Kozus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Grinding Stones for the Guard
english.objectives: Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of grinding stones.  Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
english.progress: You have something for me?
english.completion: Excellent.  We were in need of these, $n.  Good work.
english.completed: Return to Vish Kozus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 部落需要锡锭！
text.objectives: 把20块锡锭交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的步兵玛乌格。
text.description: 你好，$R。我没有很多时间来向你进行解释。我们现在正在准备和安其拉开战，但是首先，酋长决定要我们进行一些工作，这些工作被称为“备战”。这意味我需要派你出去帮我收集锡锭，我想我需要的锡锭数量连我自己都数不过来。$B$B你还留在这里干什么？
text.progress: 掘泥打击者是一个很严重的威胁，必须马上解决他们!
text.completion: 你赢得了我最诚挚的敬意。你对於塞纳里奥城堡的帮助显示了你真正的勇气。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Grunt Maug in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Tin Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Lok'tar, $r, I'm sure you already know that we're going to war at Ahn'Qiraj with the insects. But first the Warchief has decided that we're going to do something called 'prepare'. Though I'd rather be sharpening weapons and hammering armor into shape, I'm proud to have been chosen to be in charge of tin bar collection here. But I cannot do that without your help.$B$BSo I need you to go out and make tin bars and bring them back to me here. I think I'm going to need more than I can count.$B$B
english.completed: Return to Grunt Maug in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多锡锭！
text.objectives: 带20个锡锭给杜洛塔的步兵玛乌格。
text.description: 很好，我看的出来你对战争很认真。不过我对战争要开始有点急躁，所以如果你不快点把东西带来我就会生气。或许我可以直接拿你开刀。$B$B哈！还是不要好了，因为这样谁会帮我带锡锭来呢？
text.progress: 很好，我看的出你对这场战争很用心。我有点期盼战争可以赶快开始，我想你应该也是一样，$C。当战争开始时一定会是很光荣的。部落这在希利苏斯沙漠的尘土上奔驰着，手上拿着武器，冲锋陷阵在无数的虫群之中。总有一天将会取得极大的荣耀!$B$B哈!但是首先我们需要锡锭。真有趣，这样的小东西却可以带来巨大的不同，你说不是吗?
text.completion: (兽人语)你好，$N。你带来的锡锭让我和部落都感到荣耀。我会把它们堆放好并用它们制作东西。然后一切都准备好的时候我们就会上战场，教教渺小的联盟如何打仗。$B$B现在帮我带更多的锡锭回来!
text.completed: Return to Grunt Maug in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Tin Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 tin bars to Grunt Maug in Durotar.
english.description: Very good, I see that you are serious about the war. I'm a little edgy waiting for it to start though, which means I'm going to get angry if you don't start bringing in the goods faster. Maybe I can just practice on you instead.$B$BHar! Maybe not, 'cuz then who would bring me back the tin bars?
english.completed: Return to Grunt Maug in Durotar.

text.title: 征服者的肩铠
text.objectives: 把其拉命令腕轮、2个夜晚塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Conqueror's Spaulders
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.$B$BBring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 部落需要秘银锭！
text.objectives: 带20个秘银锭给奥格玛精神谷的资深士官克拉恩。
text.description: $C，战争就要来临而我们唯一能做的事就是做好准备。这就是我们要互相帮忙的时候了。告诉你，他们叫我负责收集所有制作必备品需要的秘银锭。而我还需要更多！$B$B，所以，我希望你可以离开这里帮我们挖一些秘银来，然后将它们熔制成锭。你可以帮我们这个忙吗？
text.progress: 如果能拥有所有安其拉之战需要的秘银锭就好了。这就是你回来的原因吗?你把我的秘银锭带来了?
text.completion: 这对我们二个而言是个好的开始，$N。我又可以将这20个秘银锭放入库存清点数量了。我会记得把你的名字写在旁边，这点你可以放心。大家都会因为你的协助而感到高兴的。 你要记得回来找我因为你应该知道我们还需要更多的秘银锭。
text.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant T'kelah in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Mithril Bars!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: $C, the war it is comin' and the only thing we can do is prepare for it. That be where you and I can help each other, mon. Ya see, they put me in charge of collectin' all the mithril bars we be needin' ta build for all the things we gonna need. An I still be needin' more!$B$BSo, I be hopin' that you can get out there an mine us up some mithril, then smelt it into bars. Sound like something you can do for us?
english.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant T'kelah in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多秘银锭！
text.objectives: 带20个秘银锭给奥格玛精神谷的资深士官克拉恩。
text.description: $C，战争即将到来，我们所能做的就是准备作战。在这方面我们可以互相帮助。你看，他们派我来负责收集秘银锭，以供制作我们所需的东西。现在我需要更多秘银锭！那么，我希望你可以帮我去找来一些秘银矿石，然后熔化成锭。你可以做到这些吧？
text.completion: 做的好，$N!另外20个秘银锭，让我们离目标又更近一步了，也让我们获得更多战场材料。我会提起你的名字让部落知道你正尽你的职责帮忙。如果你有其它的秘银锭，记得要拿来这里给我。
text.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant T'kelah in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Mithril Bars!
english.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant T'kelah in Durotar.

text.title: 欢迎!
text.objectives: Bring the Falconwing Square Gift Voucher to Marsilla Dawnstar in Falconwing Square.
text.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Marsilla Dawnstar in Falconwing Square.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
text.progress: 您好!很高兴见到您!$B$B我看到您手里拿着一张特殊的礼品券，把它交给我，您就可以得到一件特殊的礼品!
text.completion: 您一定会成为一个真正的英雄，$N。欢迎您来到艾泽拉斯世界，请从我们为您精心准备的特殊礼品中挑选一件吧!$B$B

english.title: Welcome!
english.objectives: Bring the Falconwing Square Gift Voucher to Marsilla Dawnstar in Falconwing Square.
english.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Marsilla Dawnstar in Falconwing Square.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!

text.title: 志愿兵的装备
text.objectives: 把5枚作战徽章、3枚后勤徽章和7枚战术徽章交给塞纳里奥要塞的瓦古斯。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到友善声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: $N，你在与敌人作战、提供后勤补给和执行战略任务之后获得的徽章并不只是用来炫耀的。$B$B希望你还保留着它们。作为对你的鼓励，我想要奖励你一些只有塞纳里奥议会最亲近的盟友才能获得的东西。
text.progress: 你完成必要的任务了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。请接受这个代表塞纳里奥议会的象徵。这是你应得的，朋友!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Volunteer's Battlegear
english.objectives: Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
english.description: The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, $N.$B$BYou'd be wise to hold on to them.  As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
english.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 部落需要宁神花！
text.objectives: 把20朵宁神花交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的草药学家波德·飞羽。
text.description: 据说每一代人都需要面对一次决定性的试炼。恐怕安其拉之战将是我们这一辈人所要经历的残酷考验。我们要做好准备，了解自己的实力究竟如何。$B$B我在这里志愿帮忙收集宁神花，我们会用它们制作战争所需的药水。我希望你来这里是为了帮助我们，如果是这样的话，那么我需要你帮我带回大量的这种草药。你会帮助我吗，$C？
text.progress: 这么快就带着宁神花回来了吗，$C?
text.completion: 这可不是简单的工作，但你却出色地完成了它。不过，不要以为你已经令我折服了，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Herbalist Proudfeather in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Peacebloom!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: It is said that every generation must face a defining trial. I fear the Ahn'Qiraj War will be the crucible in which our mettle is tested. So we prepare, and in so doing find what we are made of.$B$BI have volunteered to help the Horde by gathering as much peacebloom as possible, so that it can be made into potions for the war. I hope that you are here to lend me your aid. If so, then I need you to bring back to me a good quantity of the herb. Will you assist me, $c?
english.completed: Return to Herbalist Proudfeather in Durotar.

text.title: The Horde Needs More Peacebloom!
text.objectives: 把20朵宁神花交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的草药学家波德·飞羽。
text.description: 据说每一代人都需要面对一次决定性的试炼。恐怕安其拉之战将是我们这一辈人所要经历的残酷考验。我们要做好准备，了解自己的实力究竟如何。我在这里志愿帮忙收集宁神花，我们会用它们制作战争所需的药水。我希望你来这里是为了帮助我们，如果是这样的话，那么我需要你帮我带回大量的这种草药。你会帮助我吗，牧师？
text.completion: 谢谢你不断的努力，$N。你无私的奉献带给你自己和你的祖先无上的荣耀，而且大家都会知道!我要先把这些草药收好让它们在使用前保持新鲜。你再一次的展现了最真实的部落精神，可以战胜困难并允诺我们一起努力的精神。
text.completed: Return to Herbalist Proudfeather in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Peacebloom!
english.completed: Return to Herbalist Proudfeather in Durotar.

text.title: 船长的箱子
text.objectives: 将斯莫特的箱子交给藏宝海湾的海克拜瑞·斯莫特。
text.description: 我过去在一条专跑从这里到卡利姆多的棘齿城的航线上干过。我是个很优秀也很有名望的船长。$B$B直到……$B$B那些该死的海巨人毁了我的生活！他们打沉了我的船，杀光了我的水手，把我丢在一条救生艇上，让我漂回了藏宝海湾。还有，其中一个名叫高拉什的巨人还把我的箱子给偷走了，他说要拿这东西当鼻烟盒，简直是神经病！$B$B我听说有人看见高拉什最近在东边的海岸一带闲逛。找到他，把我的箱子给抢回来！快去，你会得到一位船长的敬意的。
text.progress: 我过去在一条专跑从这里到卡利姆多的棘齿城的航线上干过。我是个很优秀也很有名望的船长。$B$B直到……$B$B那些该死的海巨人毁了我的生活！他们打沉了我的船，杀光了我的水手，把我丢在一条救生艇上，让我漂回了藏宝海湾。还有，其中一个名叫高拉什的巨人还把我的箱子给偷走了，他说要拿这东西当鼻烟盒，简直是神经病！$B$B我听说有人看见高拉什最近在东边的海岸一带闲逛。找到他，把我的箱子给抢回来！快去，你会得到一位船长的敬意的。
text.completion: 你找到它啦!啊，今天我太高兴啦!谢谢你，$N。得到这个箱子之後，我内心里的愤懑也就平息了。$B$B但我还是要复仇……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Hecklebury Smotts at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: The Captain's Chest
english.objectives: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
english.description: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor.  I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.$B$BUntil...$B$BThose cursed sea giants ruined me!  They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay.  And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest.  He said he wanted it for a snuffbox.  The nerve!$B$BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here.  Find him and get back my chest!  Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
english.progress: Ahoy, $n!  Did you find Gorlash?  That chest was my favorite, and it has a hidden compartment that held my greatest treasures!
english.completion: You found it!  Oh happy day, this is!  Thank you, $n.  Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me. But my revenge isn't complete...
english.completed: Return to Captain Hecklebury Smotts at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 刺着字母的腰带
text.objectives: 将刺着字母的腰带还给他的主人。
text.description: 这条精致的腰带的边上刺着两个字母“HS”。
text.progress: 你好。你有什麽事吗?
text.completion: 你把我的束带找回来了?这麽说……你一定已经把海巨人摩卡什干掉了!万岁!$B$B摩卡什正是那些把我的船搞沉、把我的船员们都杀光的三个海巨人之一。$B$B那已经是第三次了。$B$B你确实是一位优秀的$C，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Find the Monogrammed Sash's owner at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: The Monogrammed Sash
english.objectives: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner.
english.description: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.
english.progress: Hello.  Do you have business with me?
english.completion: You recovered my sash?  Then...you must have killed Mok'rash the sea giant!  Hooray! I'm glad the scurvy villain's dead - Mok'rash was one of three sea giants who smashed my ships and killed my crew. Three times. You are a $c of worth, $n.
english.completed: Find the Monogrammed Sash's owner at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 船长的弯刀
text.objectives: 与斯普罗格谈一谈。
text.description: 我的第一条船被那些海巨人们搞沉了之后，我只好买了第二艘，而且给它起名为“斯莫特的复仇”。我为它配备了新的装备和船员，并出发去寻找那些该死的巨人。我找到了他们，但……他们又一次击败了我们。他们把“斯莫特的复仇”号给打成了碎片，船员也几乎被他们杀光了，但那帮混蛋却把我丢在了一条救生艇上，让我一个人漂了回来。$B$B这次，那些海巨人中的另外一个偷了我的弯刀。$B$B到奈古拉什那里去把我的佩刀给抢回来！$B$B去和斯普罗格谈谈吧。他本来是“斯莫特的复仇”号上的厨子，沉船的时候他也幸存了下来，我想他能帮你们找到那些巨人。
text.completion: 你好你好，$N。船长大人跟我说你要去找奈古拉什的晦气，呵呵，是真的吗?
text.completed: Speak with Sprogger at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: The Captain's Cutlass
english.objectives: Speak with Sprogger.
english.description: After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another.  Named Smotts' Revenge, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains.  I found them, but...they beat me.  They smashed Smotts' Revenge, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.$B$BThis time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.$B$BFace Negolash and bring me my cutlass!$B$BSpeak with Sprogger.  He was my cook on the Smotts' Revenge, and survived the last attack.  He can help you find the giant.
english.completion: Hello hello, $N.  Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?
english.completed: Speak with Sprogger at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 挑战奈古拉什
text.objectives: 将10块烧烤秃鹰翅膀和5瓶密林葡萄酒带到斯莫特船长的救生艇上去。$B$B然后杀死奈古拉什，将斯莫特的弯刀交给荆棘谷的斯莫特船长。
text.description: 奈古拉什总是一副随时准备把一切都吞下去充饥的样子。$B$B那些巨人袭击我们的船的时候，奈古拉什直接冲向了我的厨房，不过他可不像其他巨人那样喜欢吃人。奈古拉什要的是酒……还有我秘制的烧烤秃鹰翅膀。嘿，这可都是我的拿手菜，我当年可是跑到荒芜之地才弄到这食谱的！$B$B如果你想把奈古拉什给引出来，只要用点酒再加上一碟烤翅就行啦。把这些东西放进我们当初丢在东南边海岸上的救生艇里，然后你就等着奈古拉什闻到食物的味儿乖乖上钩吧！
text.progress: 把我的弯剑抢回来没有，$N?
text.completion: 你把我的弯剑从奈古拉什那儿抢回来啦!我简直不敢相信这是真的，$N!自从见到你之后，我似乎就时来运转了呀，没错，肯定是这样的!$B$B谢谢你!以后，要是我能再搞到一条新船的话，你要出海就尽管来找我，我让你随便坐，你永远都是我最欢迎的客人!
text.completed: Return to Captain Hecklebury Smotts at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Facing Negolash
english.objectives: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.$B$BKill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.
english.description: Negolash is a hungry giant.$B$BWhen the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen.  He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants.  Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings.  They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the Badlands for the recipe!$B$BIf you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings.  Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast.  When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!
english.progress: Did you get my cutlass, $n?
english.completion: You got my cutlass from Negolash!  I can't believe my fortune, $n!  Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there! Thank you!  And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.
english.completed: Return to Captain Hecklebury Smotts at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 守护之龙
text.completion: 伊兰尼库斯、瓦拉斯塔兹、和艾索雷葛斯……你的确知道这些龙，凡人。这不是巧合，他们看守我们的世界，扮演着如此有影响力的角色。$B$B不幸的是(有部份也要怪我涉世未深)不论是上古诸神的密探或者称他们为朋友的背叛者，每个守卫都沦陷了。其程度只加深了我对你的种族的不信任。$B$B找到他们……$R，做好最坏的准备吧。$B$B

english.title: The Charge of the Dragonflights
english.completion: Eranikus, Vaelastrasz, and Azuregos... No doubt you know of these dragons, mortal. It is no coincidence, then, that they have played such influential roles as watchers of our world.$B$BUnfortunately (and my own naivety is partially to blame) whether by agents of the Old Gods or betrayal by those that would call them friend, each guardian has fallen to tragedy. The extent of which has fueled my own distrust towards your kind.$B$BSeek them out... And $R, prepare yourself for the worst.

text.title: 坚定力量之戒
text.objectives: 将1枚其拉将领戒指、2个柔光雕像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给唤风者耶萨德拉。
text.description: 据说其拉虫人的军官所佩戴的戒指可以给他们带来无穷的能量。那些戒指上镶嵌着腐化的宝石，也许我们可以用纯净的材料替换它们，以此来制作净化版本的戒指。$B$B那些装饰在其拉雕像上的宝石就非常合适，它们的质量非常好。$B$B把戒指和雕像交给我，我会为你制作一枚强大的戒指，$C。
text.progress: 你帮我把戒指和材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 我会帮你把戒指上的宝石换下来。你会发现效果会变的比较…协调。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Yessendra at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Signet of Unyielding Strength
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus.  You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities.  The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.$B$BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.$B$BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
english.progress: Did you bring me the ring and materials, $n?
english.completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you.  You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Yessendra at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 坚定力量披风
text.objectives: 将1件其拉军用披风、2个玛瑙雕像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给凯伊·迅爪。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到崇敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 我很高兴听说你愿意帮助我们进攻安其拉，$N。我可以制作一件装备，让你在作战时获得一些保护，$C。$B$B我需要一件其拉斗篷，然后把它按照你的体型进行修改。我还需要其拉塑像和圣甲虫，这样我才能制作合适的扣子。$B$B我保证你一定不会失望的。
text.progress: 你帮我带来了披风的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 啊，太好了……这件披氅非常完美。$B$B拿着这个披氅，$N。愿它保护你对抗其拉虫人的邪恶魔法。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Keyl Swiftclaw at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Drape of Unyielding Strength
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus.  You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N.  I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.$B$BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course.  I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.$B$BI promise you won't be disappointed.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials for the cloak, $n?
english.completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate. Take this cloak, $n.  May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Keyl Swiftclaw at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 坚定力量之镰
text.objectives: 将1件其拉尖刺刀柄、2个雪白雕像、5个水晶甲虫和5个岩石甲虫交给希利苏斯的守望者哈尔洛。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到崇拜声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人和他们的奴仆所使用的装备是由最珍稀宝贵的物品制作而成的，包括古代巨兽的骨头，大地最深处的宝石，以及最坚硬纯净的金属。$B$B这些其拉神器让我有一种冲动，想要用一些这样的材料来锻炼我的技艺。向塞纳里奥议会证明你的忠诚吧，$N，我会用最好的其拉虫人材料帮你制作一把强大的武器。
text.progress: 你把我要的材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$C。真是把杰作之剑……它的平衡感非常完美。$B$B拿着你的武器，$N。带着无比的自信使用它并消灭我们的敌人吧!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Warden Haro at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Sickle of Unyielding Strength
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2  Alabaster Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus.  You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.$B$BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces.  Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I require, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $c.  This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect. Take your weapon, $n.  Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!
english.completed: Return to Warden Haro at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 征服者的胫甲
text.objectives: 把其拉命令腕轮、2个战争塑像、5个象牙甲虫和5个黄金甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人的魔法古老而又强大，它们最强大的武器甚至可以与龙抗衡。$B$B把其拉统御腕轮和其它辅助材料交给我，我将为你制作一双威力无比的靴子。$B$B你会在与敌人作战的时候发现它所蕴含的力量。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。你已证明你不是普通的人类。$B$B我把这些东西给你，相信它们可以帮助你击败万恶的其拉虫人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Conqueror's Greaves
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of War, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
english.progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 征服者的腿铠
text.objectives: 把奥罗的外皮、2个死亡塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 你想要向我们证明你的价值吗，凡人？很好，也许我们可以互相帮助。$B$B在传说中，古老的沙虫奥罗是一个非常强大的存在。据说是上古把它创造出来的原因是为了嘲笑生命的软弱。$B$B它的皮肤非常特殊……异常结实，甚至是无法击破的，而它本身的移动速度却不会因此而受到任何妨碍，它和那些小型生物一样动作灵敏。$B$B把它的皮肤样品和其它一些原材料都交给我，我会给你制作一条具有强大力量的护腿。
text.progress: 你把我要的材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 太好了……这块虫的皮肤会是很棒的保护层。和我们在路上摧毁的其拉材料结合，这会是个令人畏惧的护甲。愿它协助你面对里面难以言喻的恐怖。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Conqueror's Legguards
english.objectives: Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.$B$BThe ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.$B$BHis skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.$B$BBring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
english.progress: Did you bring the components I require, $n?
english.completion: Yes... the worm's hide will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 征服者的皇冠
text.objectives: 把维克尼拉斯的头饰、2个太阳塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个水晶甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 双子皇帝……他们正向我轻声密语，这折磨着我的神志。他们嘲笑我，他们知道我无法进入神殿的深处去拯救我的兄弟亚雷戈斯。$B$B我可以看见他们狰狞的脸庞，他们头上戴着具有无穷力量的皇冠。但是我必须要报仇……我会把这种代表其拉虫人力量的饰品转化成对我们有利的东西。$B$B把我需要的材料交给我，$N。我会为你制作一顶具有超凡力量的头盔。
text.progress: 你有带我要的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 你成功了!双子帝王的耳语停止了。$B$B收下这个奖励。看它一眼就会在其拉的心中注入恐惧…这会让他们想起死去的领导者还有杀死他们的人类。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Conqueror's Crown
english.objectives: Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 征服者的胸甲
text.objectives: 把上古之神的外鞘、2个战争塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给安其拉的温瑟拉。你必须在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到尊敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 最令人恐怖的上古之神正在从安其拉的休眠之中慢慢醒来。艾泽拉斯世界不久之后即将面对这股恐怖的力量，时间对于如此强大的存在来说毫无意义。$B$B当星辰的位置合适的时候，他将让恐怖的力量席卷所有的一切。你必须在此之前找到他，消灭他。$B$B完成这个任务，把他的外壳交给我。我会奖励你一件凡人从未见到过的护甲……一件只有弑神者才有资格获得的护甲！
text.progress: 在安其拉的住所里，可怕的克苏恩在睡眠中等待着。
text.completion: 我没想到你会回来，$N。$B$B你已达到比最不朽的生物还伟大的命运。$B$B杀死克苏恩不只拯救了整个艾泽拉斯，你还削弱了超乎你能理解的宇宙大事。$B$B收下这个胸甲做为光荣的象徵和伴随你行为而来的重担。$B$B愿它的力量能在等待着你的挑战中协助你，弑神者!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Conqueror's Breastplate
english.objectives: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of War, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
english.progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
english.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
english.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 术士训练
text.objectives: 与逐日岛太阳之塔内的术士训练师召唤者泰里拉伦谈一谈。
text.description: 既然你已经在你所选择的职业上有所进步，那么你一定会希望能够获得更多来自职业训练师的指导。逐日岛上有一位名叫召唤者泰里拉伦的术士训练师。去和他谈谈吧，看看他能教会你些什么。当然，你得付点学费。$B$B召唤者泰里拉伦跟逐日岛其他训练师都在太阳之塔的下层。
text.completion: $n - your name has passed my ears as one seeking out a master in the ways of the $c.  You look capable enough, but I seek more than just looks from my students.  You must be ready to delve where others fear to look to gain your power.  I will teach you, but I will not tolerate failure. There will be monetary costs associated with your training, but you should be more concerned with the cost your mind is willing to make.  If you are ready, we shall begin.

english.title: Warlock Training
english.objectives: Speak with Summoner Teli'Larien - the Warlock class trainer - inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
english.description: As you advance within your class, you will want to take advantage of the training that your class trainer can provide you.  For young warlocks here on Sunstrider Isle, your trainer is Summoner Teli'Larien.  Speak with Summoner Teli'Larien and see what training he has available for you.  The things he will teach do have a cost, so bring some coin with you.$B$BYour trainer - as with all the trainers on Sunstrider Isle - is inside the Sunspire on the lower level.
english.completion: $n - your name has passed my ears as one seeking out a master in the ways of the $c.  You look capable enough, but I seek more than just looks from my students.  You must be ready to delve where others fear to look to gain your power.  I will teach you, but I will not tolerate failure. There will be monetary costs associated with your training, but you should be more concerned with the cost your mind is willing to make.  If you are ready, we shall begin.

text.title: Priest Training
text.objectives: Speak with Matron Arena - the Priest class trainer - inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
text.description: As you advance within your class, you will want to take advantage of the training that your class trainer can provide you.  For young priests here on Sunstrider Isle, your trainer is Matron Arena.  Speak with the matron and see what training she has available for you.  The things she will teach do have a cost, so bring some coin with you.$B$BMatron Arena - as with all the trainers on Sunstrider Isle - is inside the Sunspire on the lower level.
text.completion: Welcome, $n - I am Matron Arena.  I offer my services to those who seek to learn the ways of the $c.  Such a path is often misconstrued as a path of pacifism; for we blood elves, this couldn't be further from the truth.  While we do mend both bone and spirit, we also act as a fist of vengeance for those who would transgress against us. I will train you, but all I ask is that you cover any training costs that may come up, and that you learn with an open mind.  If you agree to this, we may begin.
