text.title: 精兵的装备
text.objectives: 把5枚后勤徽章、10枚战术徽章和10枚作战徽章交给塞纳里奥要塞的瓦古斯。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到友善声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: $N，你在与敌人作战、提供后勤补给和执行战略任务之后获得的徽章并不只是用来炫耀的。$B$B希望你还保留着它们。作为对你的鼓励，我想要奖励你一些只有塞纳里奥议会最亲近的盟友才能获得的东西。
text.progress: 你完成必要的任务了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。请接受这个代表塞纳里奥议会的象徵。这是你应得的，朋友!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Veteran's Battlegear
english.objectives: Bring 7 Cenarion Combat Badges, 4 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 4 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.$B$B
english.description: The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, $N.$B$BYou'd be wise to hold on to them.  As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
english.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 勇士的装备
text.objectives: 把15枚作战徽章、20枚后勤徽章、20枚战术徽章和1枚塞纳留斯印记交给塞纳里奥要塞的瓦古斯。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到崇拜声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: $N，你在与敌人作战、提供后勤补给和执行战略任务之后获得的徽章并不只是用来炫耀的。$B$B希望你还保留着它们。作为对你的鼓励，我想要奖励你一些只有塞纳里奥议会最亲近的盟友才能获得的东西。
text.progress: 你完成必要的任务了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。请接受这个代表塞纳里奥议会的象徵。这是你应得的，朋友!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Champion's Battlegear
english.objectives: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 20 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Cenarius to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.$B$B
english.description: The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, $N.$B$BYou'd be wise to hold on to them.  As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
english.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 忠诚者的装备
text.objectives: 干得好，$N。请接受这份来自塞纳里奥议会的礼物，朋友！
text.description: $N，你在与敌人作战、提供后勤补给和执行战略任务之后获得的徽章并不只是用来炫耀的。$B$B希望你还保留着它们。作为对你的鼓励，我想要奖励你一些只有塞纳里奥议会最亲近的盟友才能获得的东西。
text.progress: 你完成必要的任务了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。请接受这个代表塞纳里奥议会的象徵。这是你应得的，朋友!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Stalwart's Battlegear
english.objectives: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
english.description: The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Windcaller Proudhorn are more than just for show, $N.$B$BYou'd be wise to hold on to them.  As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
english.completed: Return to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 艾索雷葛斯的魔法账本
text.objectives: 把魔法账本交给塔纳利斯的纳瑞安。
text.description: <你无法理解这上面的字。你甚至不知道这些文字是什么语言！>
text.progress: 喔!魔法跳动的东西!是给我的吗?
text.completion: <纳里安积极地检视字母。>$B$B太特别了，$R!这是什么?我完全看不懂龙语。

english.title: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
english.objectives: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
english.description: You cannot understand a single word on this ledger. You don't even know what language it is written in!
english.progress: Ooooh! Magical pulsing thingy! For me?
english.completion: Outstanding, $r! What is it? I can't read a lick of Draconic.

text.title: 翻译龙语
text.completion: 先处理当务之急，$N!我们必须搞清楚艾索雷葛斯到底在石板上写了什麽。$B$B你说他叫你做一个奥金浮标而这只是个概要图吗?可是他会用龙语写还真奇怪。那个讨厌的老家伙知道我看不懂这乱七八糟的文字。$B$B如果有用的话，我需要我的水晶球护目镜，一只500磅的鸡和〝龙语傻瓜教程〞第二卷。不需要按照顺序。$B$B

text.title: 斯图沃尔，前任死党
text.objectives: 纳瑞安要你找到他的前任死党斯图沃尔，从他那里拿回从纳瑞安那里偷走的占卜眼镜。
text.description: 如果我要翻译东西的话，就得戴上我的占卜眼镜。不幸的，很久以前，我的眼镜就被我的前任死党给偷走了，他就是斯图沃尔。他把我打翻在地，然后拿走了眼镜，把我留在了这里。$B$B在我忠实的水晶球的帮助下，我现在找到他了！他要么就在银松森林的格雷迈恩之墙，要么就在遍地传送门的外域，那里现在到处都是燃烧军团的家伙。你要追踪到他，然后把我的眼镜拿回来，$N！
text.completion: 真不敢相信他竟找到了我。我还以为我在外域时就与他走失了。我不会回去那里的，$R!不会，绝对不会!我受够了当他兼职的好朋友和全职的佣人。

english.title: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
english.objectives:
Narain Soothfancy wants you to find his ex-best friend forever (BFF),

$B Stewvul, and take back the scrying goggles that Stewvul stole from him.
english.description: If I am to translate anything, I will need my scrying goggles. Unfortunately, those were stolen quite some time ago by my ex-best friend forever, Stewvul. He broke my heart in five places and then left me here to rot.$B$BWith the help of my trusty crystal ball, I've isolated his whereabouts to either the Greymane Wall in Silverpine or what appears to be a portal world in the Outland that is currently being overrun by the Burning Legion. You're going to have to track him down and get my goggles back, $N!
english.completion: I can't believe he found me. I thought for sure that I'd lost him when I was in the Outland. I'm not going back there, $r! No way, no how! I'm through being his part time best friend forever and full time slave.

text.title: 占卜眼镜？没问题！
text.objectives: 找到纳瑞安的占卜眼镜。
text.description: <你听到箱子里面传来一个声音。>$B$B你只需要他的占卜眼镜？很好！这不是问题……给我一分钟……嘿！该死……在哪里！$B$B好吧，我这里有一些坏消息，还有一些更坏的消息。坏消息是我把眼镜给弄丢了。更坏的消息是，我是上个星期在熔火之心里晃悠的时候把它给弄丢的。是的，熔火之心……我想这不是我能搞定的了！再见！
text.progress: 熔火之心啊?我希望我的护目镜还完好如初!
text.completion: 太好了!我把那只500磅的鸡和第二卷的＂龙语傻瓜教程″放在哪了???喔，这是给你的一点小意思!
text.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

english.title: Scrying Goggles? No Problem!
english.objectives: Find Narain's Scrying Goggles and return them to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
english.description: <You hear a sigh of relief escape the crate.>$B$BYou just want his scrying goggles? Great! That will be no problem... Just give me a minute to... Hey! Where the... Dagnabbit!$B$BWell, there's some bad news and some worse news. The bad news is that I lost the goggles. The worse news is that I lost them when I was nosing around in the Molten Core last month. Yep, the Molten Core... I guess that concludes our business! Bye!
english.progress: The Molten Core, eh? I hope my goggles are still in one piece!
english.completion: Outstanding! Now where did I put that 500 pound chicken and Volume II of "Draconic For Dummies???" Oh, and here's a little something for all your hard work!
english.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

text.title: 凡人中的勇士
text.progress: 杀死其拉主使者对人类而言是个显着的成就，$N。无论如何，他们拥有强大的能量与数量。继续对抗他们以证明自已成为我们勇士的价值。
text.completion: 你继续好好的效忠我们吧，$N。我们的协定依然存在。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz.

english.title: Mortal Champions
english.completion: I see that you're no ordinary mortal, $n.  Your chances against the Old God, however infinitely small, are greater than ours at this point.  After all, while he expects dragons at his doorstep, he is not prepared for someone like you. Just as Anachronos and Staghelm defeated the Qiraji a thousand years ago through the alliance of mortal and dragon races, we too shall form a pact.  Gain the trust of the Bronze Dragonflight and you'll gain our trust.  Only then we shall make a true champion out of you.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz.

text.title: 部落需要火焰花！
text.objectives: 带20朵火焰花给奥格玛精神谷的蝙蝠骑士比雷凯基。
text.description: 嘿，$C。是你啊！部落认为这次的安其拉之战需要很多的火焰花。或许他们会将它拿来做些好东西。或许他们会拿来当蒸气坦克的燃料再送给联盟？谁知道？比雷凯基也不知道！$B$B 不过比雷凯基知道这件事就是了……他知道你会帮他的忙并带回很多火焰花，对吗？
text.progress: 你完成了样本收集工作吗?拯救诺格刻不容缓!
text.completion: 祈祷吧，朋友!希望我们能拯救诺格!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Batrider Pele'keiki in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Firebloom!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Hey, $c. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the Horde thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the Alliance as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!$B$BPele'keiki know this though... he know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?
english.completed: Return to Batrider Pele'keiki in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多火焰花！
text.objectives: 带20朵火焰花给奥格玛精神谷的蝙蝠骑士比雷凯基。
text.description: 嘿，$C。就是你！部落需要非常大量的火焰花来支援安其拉之战。也许他们会把火焰花用在一些爆炸物中，也许还会把它们交给联盟来作为蒸汽坦克的燃料？谁知道？但这不是关键！这不关比雷凯基的事情！比雷凯基只知道……只知道你会帮助他收集很多火焰花，对不对？
text.completion: 这不是开玩笑吧，$C?你这么快就帮比雷凯基带火焰花来了吗?比雷凯基现在就要算算它们的数量!你让比雷凯基感到很开心，他会告诉大家$N是有史以来最棒的火焰花收集者。比雷凯基等不及开战了。现在我们真的把希利苏斯的天空点亮了，对吧$G兄弟:姐妹;?!
text.completed: Return to Batrider Pele'keiki in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Firebloom!
english.completed: Return to Batrider Pele'keiki in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要紫莲花！
text.objectives: 带20朵紫莲花给奥格玛精神谷的药剂师耶泽尔。
text.description: $C，紫莲花是一种试剂，可以拿来做很多药水、药剂和油，有些对我们安其拉战役很有帮助。我们需要为战役制作数量庞大的药水。而且我也要做些实验找出紫莲花更多的功用。但是我需要大量的花才能做这些事。$B$B那是你进来的地方。走出去，采集越多紫莲花越好。这是你能办到的事吗？
text.progress: 你找到大使了吗，$N?他死了吗?$B$B我们承受不起让天谴军团在卡林多建立据点的威胁。现在我们陷入了两面作战的境地，这足以说明他们已经对我们构成了足够的威胁。$B$B你告诉我的事情中唯一让我感到乐观的事情就是那个野猪人的首领看起来还未被腐蚀。她肯定知道天谴军团可能会带来巨大的力量，但如果她同意接受他们的条件，贫瘠之地并不会真正成为她的地盘。
text.completion: 很好。干得漂亮，$C。$B$B现在玛克林死了，我们至少知道天谴军团的行动被延缓了。黑暗女王对你的行动表示感谢，并希望给你一份礼物作为奖励。$B$B尽管我们不清楚天谴军团在剃刀高地的影响范围，但我敢肯定，我们很快就会揭穿他们的阴谋。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Jezel in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Purple Lotus!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: The purple lotus, $c, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.$B$BThat's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. Is this something that you are willing to do for us?
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Jezel in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多紫莲花！
text.objectives: 带20朵紫莲花给奥格玛精神谷的药剂师耶泽尔。
text.description: 紫莲花是很多药水、药剂和精油的重要材料，它对于我们准备发动的安其拉之战很重要。我们正在为这场战争准备许多药剂，而且我还希望能发掘出更多紫莲花的用途。但前提是，我们需要大量的这种花朵。这就是你来这里的目的。去收集尽可能多的紫莲花。你还擅长别的什么事情吗？
text.completion: 真是杰出又完美的表现，$N。你的努力会被表扬，你的名声也刚被传开。我会亲自监督不让这些紫莲花被浪费掉，而你的名字也将被提及。$B$B再次感谢你，如果你有更多紫莲花，不要犹豫，用最快的速度把它们拿来给我。
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Jezel in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Purple Lotus!
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Jezel in Durotar.

text.title: 少管闲事
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯的纳瑞安让你和加基森的迪尔格·奎克里弗谈一谈。
text.description: 如果说我有一些原则是你应该了解的，那就是：永远不要管我的闲事！我所做的事情都是你无法理解的。比如说：你知道精神电能整流器是什么吗？显然你不知道！这就是为什么我来负责我们的项目规划，而你负责满世界跑腿。$B$B我之前说过，如果你想继续下去的话，那么我们需要一只500磅重的鸡。$B$B到加基森去跟迪尔格·奎克里弗谈谈——他知道如何让你找到合适的品种。
text.completion: <戴格抓了抓他的头。>$B$B一只500磅的鸡?哪有这种东西!至少，现在没有了。我知道有这种鸡……死亡的黑鸡…$B$B<戴格的声音变小了。>$B$B但是，没有人可以见过那只鸡还活着讲这个故事。我有个主意能让我们双方获利，孩子。$B$B

english.title: Never Ask Me About My Business
english.objectives: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.
english.description: If there is one thing that you should know about me, it is this: NEVER ask me about my business! I work with things you simply cannot understand. Like for example: Do you know what a psychotronic muzzledorf is? Of course you don't! And that's why we leave the planning to me and the fetching to you.$B$BAs I said earlier, if this is going to work, we're going to need a 500 pound chicken.$B$BHead to Gadgetzan and speak with Dirge Quikcleave - he'll get you started on finding a suitable specimen.$B$B
english.completion: A 500 pound chicken? There's no such thing! Not anymore, at least. I knew of such a chicken... The Black Chicken of Death... But yes, nobody ever saw that chicken and lived to tell the tale. I've got an idea that could benefit the both of us, kid.

text.title: 恐怖之岛！
text.objectives: 加基森的迪尔格·奎克里弗要你去菲拉斯的恐怖之岛击杀拉克麦拉，获得拉克麦拉的肉，并从岛上收集20份奇美洛克的腰肋肉。
text.description: 传说菲拉斯恐怖之岛的那群名叫奇美洛克的奇美拉族群是最鲜美多汁的食物！现在它们之中出现了一个首领，它的肉在经过巧妙的烹调之后可以变成一盘极品大餐！$B$B去恐怖之岛杀掉拉克麦拉，然后把它的肉带回来。这就可以满足那个侏儒了，而我则需要你带一些奇美洛克的腰肋肉给我。$B$B我会给你那500磅的肉鸡和一些别的什么东西作为交换。
text.progress: 嗯……奇美洛克……
text.completion: 看看那些嫩腰肉!太棒了!$B$B关於那只鸡……嗯，让我看看。我需要几分钟策划食谱。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

english.title: The Isle of Dread!
english.objectives: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.
english.description: Legend has it that the chimaerok of the Isle of Dread in Feralas have the most succulent and tender vittles in existence! Now these chimaerok also have a daddy who, with proper preparation, may or may not look like a 500 pound chicken.$B$BHead to the Isle of Dread and kill Lord Lakmaeran and bring me his fresh carcass. That should satisfy the gnome. To satisfy me, you'll need to get your hands on some chimaerok tenderloin.$B$BDo this and you'll have your 500 pound chicken and a little something extra.$B$B
english.progress: Mmmmm... Chimaerok...
english.completion: Look at the marbleization on those tenderloins! Fantastic! Now about that chicken... Hrm, let me see. I'm going to need a few minutes to devise the recipe.
english.completed: Return to Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

text.title: 迪尔格的超美味奇美拉肉片
text.objectives: 加基森的迪尔格·奎克里弗要你给他带去20份地精火箭燃油和20份石中盐。
text.description: 我的食谱完成了！我还需要一些火箭燃料和石中盐，只要把这些调料和你带给我的肉混合起来就可以了。$B$B如果你带来了我要的东西，纳瑞安想要的那只鸡就可以完成了。
text.progress: 快一点，孩子。我们不想让肉坏掉。
text.completion: 准备好了!我要呈现给你我最棒的创作:戴格的超美味奇美拉肉片!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

english.title: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
english.objectives: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.
english.description: My recipe is complete! What I need from you now is some rocket fuel and deeprock salt. I'll handle the spices and the meat you brought me will cover the rest.$B$BAfter you bring me what I asked for, the chicken will be ready to take back to Narain.
english.progress: Hurry it up, kid. We don't want this meat to go bad.
english.completion: It's ready! I present to you my greatest creation: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops!
english.completed: Return to Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

text.title: 向纳瑞安回复
text.objectives: 把500磅的小鸡交给塔纳利斯的纳瑞安。
text.description: 我是一个不会食言的地精，孩子。这是你要的500磅的小鸡。$B$B为什么那侏儒想要一只500磅的小鸡，那我就不知道了……$B$B<迪尔格喃喃自语着。>$B$B也许那家伙想要睡在里面……肮脏的侏儒……
text.progress: 是什麽味道这麽香?
text.completion: <纳里安将两只拳头伸进那只巨大的鸡里，整张脸塞在戴格美味的佳肴里。>$B$B嗯……这真是不可思议!我吃过最好吃的鸡!$B$B

english.title: Return to Narain
english.objectives: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
english.description: I'm a goblin of my word, kid. Here's your 500 pound chicken.$B$BWhat a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know...$B$B<Dirge grumbles something unintelligible.>$B$BProbably to sleep in it... Dirty gnomes...
english.progress: What is that scrumptious smell?
english.completion: MMmmm... This is unbelievable! Best chicken I've ever had!

text.title: 部落需要重皮!
text.objectives: 带10张重皮给奥格玛精神谷的剥皮师亚曼尼。
text.description: 既然我们在准备作战，那么最好事先收集所有需要的东西，你不觉得吗?我们现在制作的主要战争材料之一是重皮。我们会在任何东西上使用到它，从增强材料到护甲，还有好的老旧防水布。$B$B但是首先我们需要弄到多一点重皮。那是你的工作，$C。磨锐你的刀，帮我带回一大堆来。然后我们再谈。
text.progress: 如果你只是要来这里碎碎念的话我可没有时间，$C。有太多堆重皮需要保存。等你至少有10张後再回来找我。
text.completion: 喔，你真的有我要的重皮。你的刀真的很锐利，$C;这些真是好皮!现在既然我们已经有了该有的东西，我一定会将你对事业的贡献让大家都知道。如果你刚好又有更多的重皮，请带来这里给我。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Skinner Jamani in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Heavy Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 Heavy Leather to Skinner Jamani at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Since we're preparing for war, it might be best if we get all of the goods we need first, don't you think, mon? One of the staples of the war materiel that we're producing is heavy leather. We'll use it for just about everything, from reinforcement to armor, and good old plain tarps too.$B$BBut first we need to get our hands on more of it. That's your job, $c. Sharpen your knife and bring me back a bundle. Then we'll talk further.
english.completed: Return to Skinner Jamani in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 部落需要更多重皮！
text.objectives: 带10张重皮给奥格玛精神谷的剥皮师亚曼尼。
text.description: 我们正在准备进行一场战争，所以我们最好首先把所有的物资准备妥当，你认为不该这样做吗，朋友？我们所需要的一类重要物资就是重皮。我们可以把它用在各个方面，强化护甲和制作防水布都用得到它。我们需要大量的重皮。这就是你的工作，牧师。磨快你的剥皮刀，给我带回大量的重皮吧。做完这件事情，我们再继续谈谈。
text.completion: 谢谢你的重皮。每一点都让我们离目标更接近。我会好好保存并确定你的名字被写在清单上，这样首领们就会知道你的努力。$B$B再次谢谢你，$N，如果你又有更多的重皮，你知道在哪里可以找的到我。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Skinner Jamani in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Heavy Leather!
english.completed: Return to Skinner Jamani in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要厚皮!
text.objectives: 带10张厚皮给奥格玛精神谷的乌玛拉中士。
text.description: 我很高兴你决定来和我谈这件事，$C。看来部落为即将来临的安其拉之战准备的差不多了。但是你和我仍要尽自己的责任。$B$B我被要求收集大量的厚皮做为战争材料，而我需要你去帮我收集。如果你决定帮忙，那就代表了部落的荣耀和感激。你会帮忙吗?
text.progress: $C，你这麽快就带着我们说的10张厚皮回来了吗?
text.completion: 做的好，$C。我相信这些厚皮会被拿来做齐柏林飞艇的增援和所有护甲及武器。谢谢你，部落也很感激你。如果你旅途中有更多的厚皮请回来找我。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Umala in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Thick Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Sergeant Umala at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I'm glad that you decided to speak to me about this, $c. It looks like the Horde's preparations for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War are in full swing. But you and I still need to do our part.$B$BI've been asked to collect a great number of thick leather skins for use in all manner of war materiel, and I need you to help me by going out there and gathering them up. There's honor and the gratitude of the Horde in it for you should you decide to help. Will you?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Umala in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 部落需要更多厚皮！
text.objectives: 带10张厚皮给奥格玛精神谷的乌玛拉中士。
text.description: 我很高兴你决定和我谈谈这个，$C。部落方面已经着手为即将开始的安其拉之战做准备了，你我都要做好自己该做的事情。我被指派来收集大量的厚皮，我需要你帮忙去收集这些东西。这项工作是你的荣耀，也是表示你对部落的忠诚的好机会。你愿意帮忙吗？
text.completion: 你办到了，$N，我就知道你可以。我再一次代表整个部落谢谢你。你的努力会被大家知道并获得诚挚的谢意。如果你找到更多厚皮愿意贡献，把它们带来这里给我吧。$B$B部落的荣耀!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Umala in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Thick Leather!
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Umala in Durotar.

text.title: 神谕者的皇冠
text.objectives: 把维克尼拉斯的头饰、2个先知塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 双子皇帝……他们正向我轻声密语，这折磨着我的神志。他们嘲笑我，他们知道我无法进入神殿的深处去拯救我的兄弟亚雷戈斯。$B$B我可以看见他们狰狞的脸庞，他们头上戴着具有无穷力量的皇冠。但是我必须要报仇……我会把这种代表其拉虫人力量的饰品转化成对我们有利的东西。$B$B把我需要的材料交给我，$N。我会为你制作一顶具有超凡力量的头盔。
text.progress: 你有带我要的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 你成功了!双子帝王的耳语停止了。$B$B收下这个奖励。看它一眼就会在其拉的心中注入恐惧…这会让他们想起死去的领导者还有杀死他们的人类。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Tiara of the Oracle
english.objectives: Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神谕者的长裤
text.objectives: 把巨型沙虫的皮、2个重生塑像、5个黄金甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 你想要向我们证明你的价值吗，凡人？很好，也许我们可以互相帮助。$B$B在传说中，古老的沙虫奥罗是一个非常强大的存在。据说是上古把它创造出来的原因是为了嘲笑生命的软弱。$B$B它的皮肤非常特殊……异常结实，甚至是无法击破的，而它本身的移动速度却不会因此而受到任何妨碍，它和那些小型生物一样动作灵敏。$B$B把它的皮肤样品和其它一些原材料都交给我，我会给你制作一条具有强大力量的护腿。
text.progress: 你把我要的材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 太好了……这块虫的皮肤会是很棒的保护层。和我们在路上摧毁的其拉材料结合，这会是个令人畏惧的护甲。愿它协助你面对里面难以言喻的恐怖。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Trousers of the Oracle
english.objectives: Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.$B$BThe ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.$B$BHis skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.$B$BBring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
english.progress: Did you bring the components I require, $n?
english.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神谕者的衬肩
text.objectives: 把其拉命令腕轮、2个重生塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Mantle of the Oracle
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.$B$BBring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 凡人中的勇士
text.description: 你继续好好的效忠我们吧，$N。我们的协定依然存在。$B$B
text.progress: 杀死其拉主使者对人类而言是个显着的成就，$N。无论如何，他们拥有强大的能量与数量。继续对抗他们以证明自已成为我们勇士的价值。
text.completion: 你继续好好的效忠我们吧，$N。我们的协定依然存在。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz.

english.title: Mortal Champions
english.completion: You continue to serve us well, $n.  Our pact remains in place.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz.

text.title: 神谕者的裹足
text.objectives: 把其拉命令腕轮、2个死亡塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个黄金甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人的魔法古老而又强大，它们最强大的武器甚至可以与龙抗衡。$B$B把其拉统御腕轮和其它辅助材料交给我，我将为你制作一双威力无比的靴子。$B$B你会在与敌人作战的时候发现它所蕴含的力量。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。你已证明你不是普通的人类。$B$B我把这些东西给你，相信它们可以帮助你击败万恶的其拉虫人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Footwraps of the Oracle
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
english.progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 龙语傻瓜教程
text.objectives: 寻找纳瑞安埋在南海的某座小岛上的书。
text.description: 我就知道总有一天这本书会有用的！幸运的是，我已经学聪明了！我把它藏了起来。$B$B不要担心，它被放在谁都找不到的地方！嗯，我需要搭乘一架直升飞机才可以到那里去。不幸的是，在我回来的路上，飞机坠毁了。就是因为这次事故，我才获得了超级侏儒精神力量！$B$B到天涯海滩那边去寻找坠毁的直升飞机，然后往南边游！你到了那里就会看到的！
text.completion: 书不见了!在土石堆上的是一张纸条。$B$B

english.title: Draconic for Dummies
english.objectives: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.
english.description: I knew that book would come in handy some day! Thankfully, I had the wit and foresight to stow it somewhere safe.$B$BDon't worry, it's in a place that nobody could ever hope to find it! I needed a gyrocopter just to get there the first time. Unfortunately I crashed it on the beach on my way back. It was through that accident that I gained these super-gnomish psychic powers!$B$BLook for my crashed gyrocopter somewhere on Land's End Beach and swim south from there! You'll know the spot when you see it!
english.completion: The book is gone! On top of the dirt mound is a note.

text.title: 敲诈
text.objectives: 把勒索信交给塔纳利斯的纳瑞安。
text.description: <便笺上用不同的字体拼凑出一段话。>$B$B我们已经拿到了你宝贵的书，侏儒。如果你想再见到它的话，那么你就必须按照我们说的来做。$B$B<以下是长达3页的具体指示说明。>$B$B把钱带来，只需你一个人来！
text.progress: 嘿，有什麽事吗?
text.completion: <纳里安的脸愤怒而发红。>$B$B他们绑架我的……书，是吗?我会让他们知道玩弄超自然地精的下场!$B$B

english.title: rAnS0m
english.objectives: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.$B$B
english.description: <The text on this note is made up of various typefaces glued onto the parchment's surface.>$B$BWe've got your precious book, gnome. If you ever want to see it again, you'll do exactly as we ask.$B$B<A detailed set of instructions is listed, spanning 3 pages.>$B$BBring the money and come alone!
english.progress: Say, what's the matter?
english.completion: Booknap my... book, will they!? I'll teach them what it means to mess with a psychic gnome!

text.title: 唱给纳瑞安的情歌
text.objectives: 把米莉蒂丝的情书交给塔纳利斯的纳瑞安。
text.description: 并不是总是有人来拜访我。上一次有人来拜访，还是那次我把那个可爱的侏儒从坠毁的机器中救出来的时候。$B$B<米莉蒂丝若有所思。>$B$B你认识他吗？他叫纳瑞安……哦，如果有人可以替我给他传个话，那就太好了。我一定要告诉他我的感觉！我知道这就是爱！就是这样的！$B$B你可以帮我传话给纳瑞安吗？我永远都不会忘记你的！
text.progress: 你身上都是鱼腥味!
text.completion: 什麽!?$B$B<纳里安开始坐立不安。>$B$B嗯……你要我怎麽做???她是一条鱼!我告诉你是一条鱼!而且我是个地精。我们是不可能在一起的。$B$B

english.title: Love Song for Narain
english.objectives: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
english.description: It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine.$B$B<Meridith gazes into nothingness, lost in a memory.>$B$BDo you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it!$B$BCould you possibly deliver a message to Narain? I would be forever indebted to you!
english.progress: You smell like fish!
english.completion: What!? Well, um... What do you want me to do??? She's a fish! A FISH I tell you! And I'm a gnome. It could never work out.

text.title: 部落需要硬甲皮!
text.objectives: 带10张硬甲皮给奥格玛精神谷的塞拉图斯。
text.description: 我发现刀子握在掌心的适合度远比刀口的锋利重要。即使是最钝的刀剑也能在危急时发挥作用。但是你和我没有这种问题，毕竟我们总会让刀锋维持在最利的状态。$B$B对吧?嗯，不重要。我有个任务要给你，$C。为了部落，还有你对安其拉之战该尽的职责，我要你去收集很多硬甲皮给我。你能做到吗?
text.progress: 帮我切割10张硬甲皮不需要这麽久的时间吧!你是不是应该磨锐你的剥皮小刀了呢?
text.completion: 很好，这算是及格的工作了，虽然有些皮看起来切割的参差不齐。没关系，任务完成了，你获得了你的奖励。我会把你的名字写在皮革旁边;我肯定部落会很感谢你的努力。如果你又有了另一批硬甲皮，请尽快将它们带来给我。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Doctor Serratus in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Rugged Leather!
english.objectives: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I find that the fit of the knife in your palm is more important than the edge on it. Even the dullest blade can be made to cut if pressure is being properly applied through it, wouldn't you agree, $c? But you and I don't have such problems as we maintain the sharpest of edges, yes? $B$BWell, no matter, I have a task for you. In service to the Horde, and to do your part for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, I want you to return to me with a number of rugged leather skins. This is something that you will do, no?
english.completed: Return to Doctor Serratus in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 部落需要更多硬甲皮！
text.objectives: 带10张硬甲皮给奥格玛精神谷的塞拉图斯。
text.description: 我发现刀子握在掌心的适合度远比刀口的锋利重要。即使是最钝的刀剑也能在危急时发挥作用。但是你和我没有这种问题，毕竟我们总会让刀锋维持在最利的状态。$B$B对吧？嗯，不重要。我有个任务要给你，$C。为了部落，还有你对安其拉之战该尽的职责，我要你去收集很多硬甲皮给我。你能做到吗？
text.completion: 练习，练习，练习。一把磨锐的好刀和使用它的技能会让你所向披靡，$N。看来这次的皮革边缘比上次切割的好。你买了新的小刀吗?$B$B我们感谢你的努力。你的捐献会被记录下来，而你的名声会远播至关心这类事情的人那里。如果你又获得了更多硬甲皮，请务必回来与我交谈，因为我可能会需要它。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Doctor Serratus in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Rugged Leather!
english.completed: Return to Doctor Serratus in Durotar.

text.title: 风暴召唤者的肩甲
text.objectives: 把其拉统御腕轮、2个生命塑像、5个黄金甲虫和5个水晶甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Stormcaller's Pauldrons
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.$B$BBring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神谕者的外套
text.objectives: 把上古之神的外鞘、2个死亡塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个水晶甲虫交给安其拉的温瑟拉。你必须在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到尊敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 最令人恐怖的上古之神正在从安其拉的休眠之中慢慢醒来。艾泽拉斯世界不久之后即将面对这股恐怖的力量，时间对于如此强大的存在来说毫无意义。$B$B当星辰的位置合适的时候，他将让恐怖的力量席卷所有的一切。你必须在此之前找到他，消灭他。$B$B完成这个任务，把他的外壳交给我。我会奖励你一件凡人从未见到过的护甲……一件只有弑神者才有资格获得的护甲！
text.progress: 在安其拉的住所里，可怕的克苏恩在睡眠中等待着。
text.completion: 我没想到你会回来，$N。$B$B你已达到比最不朽的生物还伟大的命运。$B$B杀死克苏恩不只拯救了整个艾泽拉斯，你还削弱了超乎你能理解的宇宙大事。$B$B收下这个外衣做为光荣的象徵和伴随你行为而来的重担。$B$B愿它的力量能在等待着你的挑战中协助你，弑神者!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Vestments of the Oracle
english.objectives: Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
english.progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
english.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept these vestments as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May their power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
english.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 部落需要绒线绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷绒线绷带交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的医师朗兰纳。
text.description: 你好，$C。为了准备安其拉之战，我在这里帮助部落协调收集绒线绷带。在战场上，士兵们不能指望总有医师跟着他们，所以我们要为他们准备急救包。$B$B如果你有时间的话，我需要很多绒线绷带，请把绷带交给我，我会奖励你的。
text.progress: 掘泥打击者是一个很严重的威胁，必须马上解决他们!
text.completion: 你赢得了我最诚挚的敬意。你对於塞纳里奥城堡的帮助显示了你真正的勇气。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Healer Longrunner in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Greetings, $c. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.$B$BIf you have the time, I need many wool bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
english.completed: Return to Healer Longrunner in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 部落需要更多绒线绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷绒线绷带交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的医师朗兰纳。
text.description: 你好，$C。为了准备安其拉之战，我在这里帮助部落协调收集绒线绷带。在战场上，士兵们不能指望总有医师跟着他们，所以我们要为他们准备急救包。$B$B如果你有时间的话，我需要很多绒线绷带，请把绷带交给我，我会奖励你的。
text.completion: 你是个高尚的$C，$N!我会代表部落确实记录你的贡献并让负责的人都知道你的努力。平静的走吧，如果你又找到多馀的绒线绷带再回来找我。
text.completed: Return to Healer Longrunner in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Wool Bandages!
english.completed: Return to Healer Longrunner in Durotar.

text.title: 螳螂捕蝉！
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯的纳瑞安要你去冬泉谷，把一袋金子放在绑匪的勒索信上所写的位置。他还要求你教训一下那些家伙！
text.description: 我终于想到了！我们应该这样做。我要给袋子里装满石头，然后你来负责送货。我知道他们说应该由我亲自送去之类的。$B$B<纳瑞安上下打量着你。>$B$B嗯，你也可以完成这个任务。戴上这条头巾，穿上这件长袍，拿着这袋石头，去冬泉谷的交货地点吧。$B$B我在这个工具包中帮你准备了所有必需的东西。当他们冒出来拿货的时候，就干掉他们！让他们知道惹毛了纳瑞安的下场！
text.completion: 我想我低估了这些绑架书的人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
text.objective1: 是谁控制着人造猿二号？

english.title: Decoy!
english.objectives: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.
english.description: I've got it! Here's what we're going to do. I'm going to fill a sack up with rocks and you're going to make the drop. I know it said that I should make the delivery and I'm going to - sort of.$B$B<Narain looks you up and down.>$B$BYes, you will do just fine. Take this turban, robe, and sack of rocks and head to the drop off point in Winterspring.$B$BI've included everything you need in this special kit. When they show up to pick up the goods, snuff them out! That will teach them to mess with Narain!$B$B
english.completion: I think we may have underestimated these booknappers.
english.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
english.objective1: Who Does Number Two Work For?

text.title: 部落需要魔纹布绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷魔纹绷带交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的卡隆。
text.description: 我相信你来找我是想要帮助我收集东西？很好！不管怎么样，我接受所有的帮助，并且我需要你帮忙去收集厚魔纹绷带。最好是新做的，但不是必须。把它们交给我，$C，我会给你适当的奖励的。
text.progress: 不许失败让我颜面扫地，$C!尽快带着我们讨论的魔纹布绷带回到这里。
text.completion: 很惊讶，但是差强人意。或许我低估了你的「…能力」…$C。或许吧。你完成了一个非常简单的任务，因此你会获得不成比例的奖励。但是不要让它影响到你。如果你真的想证明自己就再去帮我带回另一堆魔纹布绷带吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Lady Callow in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Mageweave Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I trust that you are speaking to me because you are going to help with the collection I have been entrusted to? Good! By whatever means, and I do mean whatever, I wish for you to gather up a good number of mageweave bandages. Fresh would be nice, but not absolutely necessary. Return them to me here, $c, and I will personally see to it that you are properly rewarded.
english.completed: Return to Lady Callow in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 部落需要更多魔纹布绷带！
text.objectives: 把20卷魔纹绷带交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的卡隆。
text.description: 你回来了?真有趣。你看我还在收集安其拉战役要用的东西。这表示我需要你再次为我收集一堆魔纹布绷带。如果你能再做一次会相当令人惊讶的$C。
text.completion: 真是太惊讶了，$C，你真的又完成了。嗯，他们都说我很会选人做事。很好，我会将你的名字记录在你的贡献旁边，这样你就能获得这项努力应得的社会利益。如果你真的想证明自己的价值，我建议你再出去收集另一堆魔纹布绷带。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Lady Callow in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Mageweave Bandages!
english.completed: Return to Lady Callow in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要符文布绷带!
text.objectives: 带20个符文布绷带给奥格玛精神谷的尼根·陶蹄。
text.description: 看来安其拉战役会造成部落和联盟间不可避免的冲突。但令人惊讶的是，这不是场双方间的战争，而是对抗异种蝎和控制他们的力量。双方都在收集打一场胜仗所需的资源。$B$B我在收集要分配给士兵们的符文布绷带。但是我没有协助是不会成功的。你能帮我这个忙吗，$C?
text.progress: 你拿到毒液了没有?
text.completion: 太棒了，你成功了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Stoneguard Clayhoof in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Runecloth Bandages!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Stoneguard Clayhoof at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: It appears inevitable that the Horde and Alliance are on a collision course for war at Ahn'Qiraj. Surprisingly, it is not a war with each other, but rather with the silithid, and whatever force controls them. Also surprisingly, both sides are doing their part to gather the resources necessary to wage a successful war.$B$BI am collecting runecloth bandages to distribute to the soldiers, but I won't be successful without assistance, hopefully yours. Is this something that you can aid me with, $c?$B$B
english.completed: Return to Stoneguard Clayhoof in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 部落需要更多符文布绷带！
text.objectives: 带20个符文布绷带给奥格玛精神谷的尼根·陶蹄。
text.description: 毫无疑问，部落和联盟在准备安其拉之战的过程中会发生摩擦。奇怪的是，这场战争居然不是在部落和联盟之间进行的，双方的敌人都是异种虫类和控制这些虫子的幕后黑手。部落和联盟都在积极收集资源来发动这场战争。$B$B我负责收集符文布绷带，但是如果我得不到帮助的话就不会成功。你能帮助我吗，$C？
text.completion: 你的付出相当地无私，$N。你解救了安其拉战士。非常感谢你对部落的慷慨解囊。如果你能制作、或是遇到更多的符文布绷带，请考虑带回来这里给我。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Stoneguard Clayhoof in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
english.completed: Return to Stoneguard Clayhoof in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要瘦狼排!
text.objectives: 带20块瘦狼排给奥格玛精神谷的血卫士拉尔塔。
text.description: 我站在这里不是为了晒成好看的小麦色，$C。是为了战争作准备。如果我们要消灭安其拉那些虫子，那么我们就要准备好，包括食物!$B$B他们要我为即将来临的战争收集并腌制瘦狼排。但是我必须留在这里处理事情，所以我需要你去杀一些狼，并将它们的肉烹煮成瘦狼排再带来给我。你听懂了吗?
text.progress: 被激怒的小精龙是非常危险的，和它们打交道要多加小心，$C。这个地区的夜精灵比它们还危险，那些烦人的蠢货也会在森林里出没。$B$B当你拿到足够多的翅膀之後就告诉我，我一定会好好奖励你的!
text.completion: 太好了，$C!这些再合适不过了，足够让科琳做一件披风，也许还要更多!谢谢你。$B$B你没碰到什麽危险吧?菲拉斯地区可不是个安全的地方，不过你显然应付得过来。$B$B再次感谢你，$C。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bloodguard Rawtar in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Lean Wolf Steaks!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Lean Wolf Steaks to Bloodguard Rawtar at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I'm not standing here just to get a nice tan, $c. There are war preparations to be made. If we're going to crush those bugs at Ahn'Qiraj then we need to be ready, and that includes food too!$B$BThey have me gathering and salting lean wolf steaks here for the upcoming war. But since I need to stay here to take care of all of this, I need you to go out, kill some wolves and then cook up the meat into lean wolf steaks and bring them back to me here. You got all that?
english.completed: Return to Bloodguard Rawtar in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多瘦狼排！
text.objectives: 带20块瘦狼排给奥格玛精神谷的血卫士拉尔塔。
text.description: 我站在这里可不是为了把自己皮肤晒成健康色的，$C。我们必须为战争做好准备。如果我们想要把那些安其拉的虫子都碾碎的话，那么我们现在就得好好准备一下了，这当然包括食物的储备工作！$B$B我们需要收集足够的狼肉来为战争做好准备。我要待在这里进行整理工作，所以我要委托你去杀几条狼，然后把它们的肉烧成瘦狼排给我。你知道该怎么做了吗？
text.completed: Return to Bloodguard Rawtar in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Lean Wolf Steaks!
english.completed: Return to Bloodguard Rawtar in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要斑点黄尾鱼!
text.objectives: 带20条有斑点的黄尾鱼给奥格玛精神谷的渔夫林度。
text.description: 今天是个钓鱼的好日子，你不觉得吗?这样很好，因为我正需要很多的鱼。部落要我负责收集一吨有斑点的黄尾鱼。他们说是安其拉战役需要的。我说我会尽力而为。所以我需要一些帮忙。你会帮我吧，$C?
text.progress: 这麽快就带着斑点黄尾鱼回来了吗，$C?你有把它们煮好吧?我们可不想在炎热的沙漠艳阳下给士兵们生鱼吃。
text.completion: 喔耶，这真是好东西。我会把它们收好，不会浪费。谢谢你帮我们这样的忙。我想你是个一流的渔夫$G先生:小姐;能钓到这些斑点黄尾鱼。如果你刚好钓到并煮好更多鱼，拿到这里给我;我要让大家都知道你的表现!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Fisherman Lin'do at Southfury River in Azshara.

english.title: The Horde Needs Spotted Yellowtail!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Fisherman Lin'do at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: It be a nice day for fishin', don't'cha think mon? Good thing, cuz I be needin' a lot of fish it lookin' like. The Horde, they askin' me to be in charge of collectin' a ton of the spotted yellowtail for them. They say they needin' it for the war they getting' ready for at Ahn'Qiraj. I say to them I do the best I can. So I be needin' to get some help. You gonna be helpin' me, $c?
english.completed: Return to Fisherman Lin'do at Southfury River in Azshara.

text.title: 部落需要更多斑点黄尾鱼！
text.objectives: 带20条有斑点的黄尾鱼给奥格玛精神谷的渔夫林度。
text.description: 真是钓鱼的好天气，你不这么认为吗，小伙子？这天气真好，我正好需要很多的鱼。部落让我负责收集大量的斑点黄尾鱼。这是为了即将开始的安其拉之战做准备。我告诉他们我会尽力而为的，所以我现在需要一些帮助。你可以帮帮我吗，$C？
text.completion: 这是最好的捕获量，$N!很好，很认真的工作。而且也没有骨头。谢谢你为这些斑点黄尾鱼到外面去。如果你又煮了更多的黄尾鱼请快点回到我这里!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Fisherman Lin'do in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
english.completed: Return to Fisherman Lin'do in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要烤鲑鱼!
text.objectives: 带20条烤鲑鱼给奥格玛精神谷的图拉·利爪。
text.description: 安其拉之战是一项浩大的工程，$C。这里收集的所有材料，不管是武器要用的金属，还是要吃的食物，所有的东西都一样重要。如果你好几天没吃东西就会没有力气在必要时举起你的斧头。$B$B因此，我们尽量收集食物。我正在收集烤鲑鱼，好保存又营养。你可以帮我这个忙吗，$C?
text.progress: 被激怒的小精龙是非常危险的，和它们打交道要多加小心，$C。这个地区的夜精灵比它们还危险，那些烦人的蠢货也会在森林里出没。$B$B当你拿到足够多的翅膀之後就告诉我，我一定会好好奖励你的!
text.completion: 太好了，$C!这些再合适不过了，足够让科琳做一件披风，也许还要更多!谢谢你。$B$B你没碰到什麽危险吧?菲拉斯地区可不是个安全的地方，不过你显然应付得过来。$B$B再次感谢你，$C。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Chief Sharpclaw in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs Baked Salmon!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Baked Salmon to Chief Sharpclaw at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
english.description: The Ahn'Qiraj war effort is an immense undertaking, $c. All of the materials being gathered here, whether it is metal for weapons, or food to eat, are all as important as the other. For, if you haven't eaten in days you will not have the strength to lift your axe when it matters.$B$BThus, we gather what food we can. I am collecting baked salmon, a dish that was chosen both for its sustenance and its ability to keep well. Can you aid me with this task, $c?
english.completed: Return to Chief Sharpclaw in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要更多烤鲑鱼！
text.objectives: 带20条烤鲑鱼给奥格玛精神谷的图拉·利爪。
text.description: 安其拉之战的准备工作是一项浩大的工程，战士。所有的物资都将在这里进行收集，无论是铸造武器所需的金属，还是士兵日常生活所需的食物都非常重要。比如说，如果你几天没有吃东西，那么你一定没有力气挥舞战斧。$B$B因此我们需要收集尽可能多的食物。我在这里负责收集烤鲑鱼，它的口味和营养都非常适合我们的士兵。你能帮帮我吗，战士？
text.completed: Return to Chief Sharpclaw in Durotar.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Baked Salmon!
english.completed: Return to Chief Sharpclaw in Durotar.

text.title: 部落需要熔火之石！
text.objectives: 把50块熔火之石交给奥格瑞玛精神谷的佐格将军。
text.description: 是时候让你为安其拉之战做出贡献了，$C。你不能继续这样游手好闲下去。现在是你为我和部落效劳的时候，而且我可不想酋长那样宽大仁慈。$B$B你必须组织起强大的力量，最好是整个公会的力量，深入熔火之心。在那里，你可以找到很多被称为熔火之石的东西。把它们都交给我。
text.completed: Return to General Zog in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Horde Needs Singed Corestones!
english.objectives: Bring 50 singed corestones to General Zog in Durotar.
english.description: The time has come for you to contribute to the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, $c. Gone are the halcyon days of whiling away your time in leisure. Now it is time to serve me and the Horde, and I assure you that I am not as forgiving as the Warchief.$B$BYou will gather your forces, a guild if you have one, and invade the Molten Core. Inside you will find that the denizens of the place have singed corestones. Bring these back to me in large quantities.
english.completed: Return to General Zog in Dun Morogh.

text.title: The Horde Needs More Singed Corestones!
text.completed: Return to General Zog in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Horde Needs More Singed Corestones!
english.completed: Return to General Zog in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 黎明长者
text.completion: 很庆幸这片大地的居民仍然会对古老的种族表达敬意。我祝你平安，$N，并且送你这个硬币……

text.title: 唯一的方案
text.objectives: 把8章《龙语傻瓜教程》的章节用魔法书封面合起来，然后把完整的《龙语傻瓜教程：第二卷》交给塔纳利斯的纳瑞安。
text.description: 我就知道，我最大的敌人，维维尔博士又开始玩他那老一套了！现在，由于你在冬泉谷的失败，维维尔把我的书给毁掉了！你现在还怎么拯救世界，大英雄？$B$B我收集到的仅存的《龙语傻瓜教程：第二卷》被撕成8份，散落在世界各地！如果你可以收集到这些遗失的章节，那么就用这个魔法书封面把它们合在一起，然后给我带回来。
text.progress: 我和你一样把裤子穿上 - 一次穿一条腿进去。只不过等你穿好了，我已经在制作奥金浮标了。奥金浮标啊，宝贝!
text.completion: 太棒了!真不敢相信你真的突破了那个难题!你是机器吗?换作是我，我可能会让整个世界爆炸。$B$B告诉你，$G先生:女士; 。英勇的行为一定会得到奖励的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

english.title: The Only Prescription
english.objectives: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
english.description: I should have known. My arch-enemy, Doctor Weavil, up to his old tricks! And now, thanks to your failure in Winterspring, Doctor Weavil has destroyed my book! How are you going to save the world now, hero?$B$BThe note I received stated that the only known copy of "Draconic for Dummies: Volume II" was ripped into 8 parts and scattered to the wind! If you somehow manage to find those missing chapters, use this magical binding to put them back together and return to me.
english.progress: I put my pants on just like you - one leg at a time. Except when my pants are on, I make arcanite buoys. Arcanite buoys, baby!
english.completion: Fantastic! I can't believe you went through the hassle! Are you some kind of machine? If it were me, I would have probably just let the world implode. I tip my turban to you, sir. And no good deed should go unrewarded.
english.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

text.title: 风暴召唤者的足甲
text.objectives: 把其拉统御腕轮、2个先知塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人的魔法古老而又强大，它们最强大的武器甚至可以与龙抗衡。$B$B把其拉统御腕轮和其它辅助材料交给我，我将为你制作一双威力无比的靴子。$B$B你会在与敌人作战的时候发现它所蕴含的力量。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Stormcaller's Footguards
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
english.progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 风暴召唤者的护甲
text.objectives: 把上古之神的外鞘、2个先知塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给安其拉的温瑟拉。你必须在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到尊敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 最令人恐怖的上古之神正在从安其拉的休眠之中慢慢醒来。艾泽拉斯世界不久之后即将面对这股恐怖的力量，时间对于如此强大的存在来说毫无意义。$B$B当星辰的位置合适的时候，他将让恐怖的力量席卷所有的一切。你必须在此之前找到他，消灭他。$B$B完成这个任务，把他的外壳交给我。我会奖励你一件凡人从未见到过的护甲……一件只有弑神者才有资格获得的护甲！
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Stormcaller's Hauberk
english.objectives: Bring the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
english.progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
english.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
english.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 风暴召唤者的王冠
text.objectives: 把维克洛尔的王冠、2个重生塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个水晶甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 双子皇帝……他们正向我轻声密语，这折磨着我的神志。他们嘲笑我，他们知道我无法进入神殿的深处去拯救我的兄弟亚雷戈斯。$B$B我可以看见他们狰狞的脸庞，他们头上戴着具有无穷力量的皇冠。但是我必须要报仇……我会把这种代表其拉虫人力量的饰品转化成对我们有利的东西。$B$B把我需要的材料交给我，$N。我会为你制作一顶具有超凡力量的头盔。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Stormcaller's Diadem
english.objectives: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 风暴召唤者的护腿
text.objectives: 把巨型沙虫的皮、2个征战塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 你想要向我们证明你的价值吗，凡人？很好，也许我们可以互相帮助。$B$B在传说中，古老的沙虫奥罗是一个非常强大的存在。据说是上古把它创造出来的原因是为了嘲笑生命的软弱。$B$B它的皮肤非常特殊……异常结实，甚至是无法击破的，而它本身的移动速度却不会因此而受到任何妨碍，它和那些小型生物一样动作灵敏。$B$B把它的皮肤样品和其它一些原材料都交给我，我会给你制作一条具有强大力量的护腿。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Stormcaller's Leggings
english.objectives: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.$B$BThe ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.$B$BHis skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.$B$BBring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
english.progress: Did you bring the components I require, $n?
english.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神秘肩垫
text.objectives: 把其拉命令腕轮、2个死亡塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个青铜甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Enigma Shoulderpads
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.$B$BBring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。你已证明你不是普通的人类。$B$B我把这些东西给你，相信它们可以帮助你击败万恶的其拉虫人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Striker's Footguards
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.

english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.progress: 在安其拉的住所里，可怕的克苏恩在睡眠中等待着。
text.completion: 我没想到你会回来，$N。$B$B你已达到比最不朽的生物还伟大的命运。$B$B杀死克苏恩不只拯救了整个艾泽拉斯，你还削弱了超乎你能理解的宇宙大事。$B$B收下这个胸甲做为光荣的象徵和伴随你行为而来的重担。$B$B愿它的力量能在等待着你的挑战中协助你，弑神者!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Enigma Leggings
english.objectives: Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.$B$BThe ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.$B$BHis skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.$B$BBring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
english.progress: Did you bring the components I require, $n?
english.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神秘头饰
text.objectives: 把维克尼拉斯的头饰、2个夜晚塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 双子皇帝……他们正向我轻声密语，这折磨着我的神志。他们嘲笑我，他们知道我无法进入神殿的深处去拯救我的兄弟亚雷戈斯。$B$B我可以看见他们狰狞的脸庞，他们头上戴着具有无穷力量的皇冠。但是我必须要报仇……我会把这种代表其拉虫人力量的饰品转化成对我们有利的东西。$B$B把我需要的材料交给我，$N。我会为你制作一顶具有超凡力量的头盔。
text.progress: 你有带我要的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 你成功了!双子帝王的耳语停止了。$B$B收下这个奖励。看它一眼就会在其拉的心中注入恐惧…这会让他们想起死去的领导者还有杀死他们的人类。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Enigma Circlet
english.objectives: Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神秘长袍
text.objectives: 把上古之神的外鞘、2个太阳塑像、5个黄金甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的温瑟拉。你必须在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到尊敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 最令人恐怖的上古之神正在从安其拉的休眠之中慢慢醒来。艾泽拉斯世界不久之后即将面对这股恐怖的力量，时间对于如此强大的存在来说毫无意义。$B$B当星辰的位置合适的时候，他将让恐怖的力量席卷所有的一切。你必须在此之前找到他，消灭他。$B$B完成这个任务，把他的外壳交给我。我会奖励你一件凡人从未见到过的护甲……一件只有弑神者才有资格获得的护甲！
text.progress: 在安其拉的住所里，可怕的克苏恩在睡眠中等待着。
text.completion: 我没想到你会回来，$N。$B$B你已达到比最不朽的生物还伟大的命运。$B$B杀死克苏恩不只拯救了整个艾泽拉斯，你还削弱了超乎你能理解的宇宙大事。$B$B收下这个长袍做为光荣的象徵和伴随你行为而来的重担。$B$B愿它的力量能在等待着你的挑战中协助你，弑神者!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Enigma Robes
english.objectives: Bring the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
english.progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
english.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept these robes as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May their power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
english.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 神秘长靴
text.objectives: 把其拉统御腕轮、2个太阳塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个青铜甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人的魔法古老而又强大，它们最强大的武器甚至可以与龙抗衡。$B$B把其拉统御腕轮和其它辅助材料交给我，我将为你制作一双威力无比的靴子。$B$B你会在与敌人作战的时候发现它所蕴含的力量。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。你已证明你不是普通的人类。$B$B我把这些东西给你，相信它们可以帮助你击败万恶的其拉虫人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Enigma Boots
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
english.progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 碎石长者
text.completion: 战争的历史是传奇茁壮的种子。你正处於英雄的时代，年轻人。愿你的英勇传奇深植人心、源远流长。$B$B祝你平安， $N，这是你应有的奖赏……$B$B

english.title: Splitrock the Elder
english.completion: The battles of ages past are seeds from which legends grow.  Yours is a time of heroes, young one.  May your legend take root, thrive.$B$BI bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

text.title: 巨石长者
text.completion: 万物皆难逃一死，但精神却永垂不朽。祝你平安， $N，这是给你的奖赏……

english.title: Rumblerock the Elder
english.completion: The stuff of life is doomed to die and return to the earth, but the stuff of spirit lives eternal.  I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

text.title: 死亡执行者的护腿
text.objectives: 把奥罗的外皮、2个夜晚塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个水晶甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 你想要向我们证明你的价值吗，凡人？很好，也许我们可以互相帮助。$B$B在传说中，古老的沙虫奥罗是一个非常强大的存在。据说是上古把它创造出来的原因是为了嘲笑生命的软弱。$B$B它的皮肤非常特殊……异常结实，甚至是无法击破的，而它本身的移动速度却不会因此而受到任何妨碍，它和那些小型生物一样动作灵敏。$B$B把它的皮肤样品和其它一些原材料都交给我，我会给你制作一条具有强大力量的护腿。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 死亡执行者的护肩
text.objectives: 把其拉命令腕轮、2个太阳塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Deathdealer's Spaulders
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.$B$BBring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races.  I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

text.title: 棱石长者
text.completion: 很庆幸这片大地的居民仍然会对古老的种族表达敬意。我祝你平安，$N，并且送你这个硬币……

text.title: 复仇者的胫甲
text.objectives: 把其拉统御腕轮、2个先知塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人的魔法古老而又强大，它们最强大的武器甚至可以与龙抗衡。$B$B把其拉统御腕轮和其它辅助材料交给我，我将为你制作一双威力无比的靴子。$B$B你会在与敌人作战的时候发现它所蕴含的力量。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。你已证明你不是普通的人类。$B$B我把这些东西给你，相信它们可以帮助你击败万恶的其拉虫人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Avenger's Greaves
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
english.progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 攻击者的护甲
text.objectives: 把上古之神的外鞘、2个生命塑像、5个黄金甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的温瑟拉。
text.description: 最令人恐怖的上古之神正在从安其拉的休眠之中慢慢醒来。艾泽拉斯世界不久之后即将面对这股恐怖的力量，时间对于如此强大的存在来说毫无意义。$B$B当星辰的位置合适的时候，他将让恐怖的力量席卷所有的一切。你必须在此之前找到他，消灭他。$B$B完成这个任务，把他的外壳交给我。我会奖励你一件凡人从未见到过的护甲……一件只有弑神者才有资格获得的护甲！
text.progress: 在安其拉的住所里，可怕的克苏恩在睡眠中等待着。
text.completion: 我没想到你会回来，$N。$B$B你已达到比最不朽的生物还伟大的命运。$B$B杀死克苏恩不只拯救了整个艾泽拉斯，你还削弱了超乎你能理解的宇宙大事。$B$B收下这个胸甲做为光荣的象徵和伴随你行为而来的重担。$B$B愿它的力量能在等待着你的挑战中协助你，弑神者!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Striker's Hauberk
english.objectives: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
english.progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
english.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
english.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 攻击者的王冠
text.objectives: 把维克尼拉斯的头饰、2个征战塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 双子皇帝……他们正向我轻声密语，这折磨着我的神志。他们嘲笑我，他们知道我无法进入神殿的深处去拯救我的兄弟亚雷戈斯。$B$B我可以看见他们狰狞的脸庞，他们头上戴着具有无穷力量的皇冠。但是我必须要报仇……我会把这种代表其拉虫人力量的饰品转化成对我们有利的东西。$B$B把我需要的材料交给我，$N。我会为你制作一顶具有超凡力量的头盔。
text.progress: 你有带我要的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 你成功了!双子帝王的耳语停止了。$B$B收下这个奖励。看它一眼就会在其拉的心中注入恐惧…这会让他们想起死去的领导者还有杀死他们的人类。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Striker's Diadem
english.objectives: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will make you a headpiece of unmatched power.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 攻击者的护腿
text.objectives: 把巨型沙虫的皮、2个太阳塑像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 你想要向我们证明你的价值吗，凡人？很好，也许我们可以互相帮助。$B$B在传说中，古老的沙虫奥罗是一个非常强大的存在。据说是上古把它创造出来的原因是为了嘲笑生命的软弱。$B$B它的皮肤非常特殊……异常结实，甚至是无法击破的，而它本身的移动速度却不会因此而受到任何妨碍，它和那些小型生物一样动作灵敏。$B$B把它的皮肤样品和其它一些原材料都交给我，我会给你制作一条具有强大力量的护腿。
text.progress: 你把我要的东西都带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Striker's Leggings
english.objectives: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.$B$BThe ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.$B$BHis skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.$B$BBring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
english.progress: Did you bring the components I require, $n?
english.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.

text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。你已证明你不是普通的人类。$B$B我把这些东西给你，相信它们可以帮助你击败万恶的其拉虫人。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Genesis Boots
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Silver Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
english.description: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
english.progress: You've acquired the items I requested, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've proven you're no ordinary mortal. I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 起源外套
text.objectives: 把上古之神的外鞘、2个重生塑像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给安其拉的温瑟拉。
text.description: 最令人恐怖的上古之神正在从安其拉的休眠之中慢慢醒来。艾泽拉斯世界不久之后即将面对这股恐怖的力量，时间对于如此强大的存在来说毫无意义。$B$B当星辰的位置合适的时候，他将让恐怖的力量席卷所有的一切。你必须在此之前找到他，消灭他。$B$B完成这个任务，把他的外壳交给我。我会奖励你一件凡人从未见到过的护甲……一件只有弑神者才有资格获得的护甲！
text.progress: 在安其拉的住所里，可怕的克苏恩在睡眠中等待着。
text.completion: 我没想到你会回来，$N。$B$B你已达到比最不朽的生物还伟大的命运。$B$B杀死克苏恩不只拯救了整个艾泽拉斯，你还削弱了超乎你能理解的宇宙大事。$B$B收下这个胸甲做为光荣的象徵和伴随你行为而来的重担。$B$B愿它的力量能在等待着你的挑战中协助你，弑神者!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Genesis Vest
english.objectives: Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
english.progress: At his dwelling in Ahn'Qiraj, dread C'Thun awaits in slumber.
english.completion: I did not expect you to return from your attempt, $n. You've fulfilled a destiny greater than that of most immortal beings. By slaying C'Thun you've not only saved all of Azeroth, you've also tipped the scales of cosmic events beyond your comprehension. Accept this breastplate as a symbol of the glory and burden that will come as a consequence of your actions. May its power aid you in the challenges that await you, god-slayer!
english.completed: Return to Vethsera in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 起源头盔
text.objectives: 把维克洛尔的王冠、2个生命塑像、5个黄金甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给安其拉的安多葛斯。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 双子皇帝……他们正向我轻声密语，这折磨着我的神志。他们嘲笑我，他们知道我无法进入神殿的深处去拯救我的兄弟亚雷戈斯。$B$B我可以看见他们狰狞的脸庞，他们头上戴着具有无穷力量的皇冠。但是我必须要报仇……我会把这种代表其拉虫人力量的饰品转化成对我们有利的东西。$B$B把我需要的材料交给我，$N。我会为你制作一顶具有超凡力量的头盔。
text.progress: 你有带我要的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 你成功了!双子帝王的耳语停止了。$B$B收下这个奖励。看它一眼就会在其拉的心中注入恐惧…这会让他们想起死去的领导者还有杀死他们的人类。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Genesis Helm
english.objectives: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: You've succeeded!  The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased. Take this as a reward.  The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... it shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 起源长裤
text.objectives: 把巨型沙虫的皮、2个战争塑像、5个岩石甲虫和5个水晶甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到友善声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 你想要向我们证明你的价值吗，凡人？很好，也许我们可以互相帮助。$B$B在传说中，古老的沙虫奥罗是一个非常强大的存在。据说是上古把它创造出来的原因是为了嘲笑生命的软弱。$B$B它的皮肤非常特殊……异常结实，甚至是无法击破的，而它本身的移动速度却不会因此而受到任何妨碍，它和那些小型生物一样动作灵敏。$B$B把它的皮肤样品和其它一些原材料都交给我，我会给你制作一条具有强大力量的护腿。
text.progress: 你把我要的材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 太好了……这块虫的皮肤会是很棒的保护层。和我们在路上摧毁的其拉材料结合，这会是个令人畏惧的护甲。愿它协助你面对里面难以言喻的恐怖。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Genesis Trousers
english.objectives: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of War, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.$B$BThe ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.$B$BHis skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.$B$BBring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
english.progress: Did you bring the components I require, $n?
english.completion: Yes... the worm's skin will make for an excellent protective layer.  Combined with the strongest parts from the Qiraji we've destroyed on our way here, this should make for a formidable piece of armor.  May it aid you in facing the unspeakable horrors that await inside!
english.completed: Return to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.

text.title: 起源护肩
text.objectives: 把其拉统御腕轮、2个征战塑像、5个黄金甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给安其拉的坎多斯特拉兹。你必须首先在诺兹多姆的子嗣中达到中立声望才可以完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说凡人所穿着的绚丽护肩是他们用来模仿龙翼的。$B$B把其拉虫人的最高领袖所佩戴的腕轮交给我，我会用它来制作一副比奈法利安的双翼还要可怕的护肩！
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: 我用你带来的材料和其拉虫人的鳞片制成了这套肩铠，凡人。希望它们能给你适时的保护也能让我们的敌人尝到恐惧的滋味。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.

english.title: Genesis Shoulderpads
english.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
english.description: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.$B$BBring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal.  May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.
