text.title: 目标：佐拉坑道蝎
text.objectives: 击杀40只佐拉坑道蝎。
text.description: 我们需要援军进攻佐拉虫巢。你的主要目标是那些佐拉坑道蝎，当你的任务完成之后就去向指挥官玛尔利斯报告。
text.progress: 你有事要告诉我，$C。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Without their tunnelers, the silithid will have a hard time repairing any damage inflicted to their hive's structure.  I assume you'll want a new task.
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Target: Hive'Zora Tunnelers
english.objectives: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Tunnelers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.$B$B
english.description: Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora.  You have been selected to target Hive'Zora tunnelers.  Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
english.progress: You have something to tell me, $c?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Without their tunnelers, the silithid will have a hard time repairing any damage inflicted to their hive's structure.  I assume you'll want a new task.
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 风路长者
text.completion: 天堂，在他们数不尽的星星中有着世间神秘事物的答案，$N。强大，有智慧，幸运的人，能够抬头盯着天空找到答案?$B$B

text.title: 无尽智慧披风
text.objectives: 将1件其拉军用披风、2个翠玉雕像、5个黄金甲虫和5个陶土甲虫交给凯伊·迅爪。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到崇敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 我很高兴听说你愿意帮助我们进攻安其拉，$N。我可以制作一件装备，让你在作战时获得一些保护，$C。$B$B我需要一件其拉斗篷，然后把它按照你的体型进行修改。我还需要其拉塑像和圣甲虫，这样我才能制作合适的扣子。$B$B我保证你一定不会失望的。
text.progress: 你帮我带来了披风的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 啊，太好了……这件披氅非常完美。$B$B拿着这个披氅，$N。愿它保护你对抗其拉虫人的邪恶魔法。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Keyl Swiftclaw at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Shroud of Infinite Wisdom
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus.  You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N.  I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.$B$BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course.  I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.$B$BI promise you won't be disappointed.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials for the cloak, $n?
english.completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate. Take this cloak, $n.  May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Keyl Swiftclaw at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 不灭生命披风
text.objectives: 将1件其拉帝王披风、2个朱红雕像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给凯伊·迅爪。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到崇敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 我很高兴听说你愿意帮助我们进攻安其拉，$N。我可以制作一件装备，让你在作战时获得一些保护，$C。$B$B我需要一件其拉斗篷，然后把它按照你的体型进行修改。我还需要其拉塑像和圣甲虫，这样我才能制作合适的扣子。$B$B我保证你一定不会失望的。
text.progress: 你帮我带来了披风的材料吗，$N?
text.completion: 啊，太好了……这件披氅非常完美。$B$B拿着这个披氅，$N。愿它保护你对抗其拉虫人的邪恶魔法。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Keyl Swiftclaw at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Cloak of Unending Life
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus.  You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N.  I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.$B$BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course.  I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.$B$BI promise you won't be disappointed.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials for the cloak, $n?
english.completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate. Take this cloak, $n.  May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Keyl Swiftclaw at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 无尽智慧之戒
text.objectives: 将1枚其拉典礼戒指、2个黑曜石雕像、5个银质甲虫和5个白骨甲虫交给唤风者耶萨德拉。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到尊敬声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 据说其拉虫人的军官所佩戴的戒指可以给他们带来无穷的能量。那些戒指上镶嵌着腐化的宝石，也许我们可以用纯净的材料替换它们，以此来制作净化版本的戒指。$B$B那些装饰在其拉雕像上的宝石就非常合适，它们的质量非常好。$B$B把戒指和雕像交给我，我会为你制作一枚强大的戒指，$C。
text.progress: 你帮我把戒指和材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 我会帮你把戒指上的宝石换下来。你会发现效果会变的比较…协调。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Yessendra at Ahn'Qiraj in Silithus.

english.title: Ring of Infinite Wisdom
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus.  You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities.  The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.$B$BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.$B$BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
english.progress: Did you bring me the ring and materials, $n?
english.completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you.  You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Yessendra at Ahn'Qiraj in Silithus.

text.description: 据说其拉虫人的军官所佩戴的戒指可以给他们带来无穷的能量。那些戒指上镶嵌着腐化的宝石，也许我们可以用纯净的材料替换它们，以此来制作净化版本的戒指。$B$B那些装饰在其拉雕像上的宝石就非常合适，它们的质量非常好。$B$B把戒指和雕像交给我，我会为你制作一枚强大的戒指，$C。
text.progress: 你帮我把戒指和材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 我会帮你把戒指上的宝石换下来。你会发现效果会变的比较…协调。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Yessendra at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Signet of the Unseen Path
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus.  You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities.  The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.$B$BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.$B$BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
english.progress: Did you bring me the ring and materials, $n?
english.completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you.  You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Yessendra at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 无尽智慧之锤
text.objectives: 将1件其拉装饰刀柄、2个柔光雕像、5个青铜甲虫和5个象牙甲虫交给希利苏斯的守望者哈尔洛。你必须在塞纳里奥议会中达到崇拜声望才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 其拉虫人和他们的奴仆所使用的装备是由最珍稀宝贵的物品制作而成的，包括古代巨兽的骨头，大地最深处的宝石，以及最坚硬纯净的金属。$B$B这些其拉神器让我有一种冲动，想要用一些这样的材料来锻炼我的技艺。向塞纳里奥议会证明你的忠诚吧，$N，我会用最好的其拉虫人材料帮你制作一把强大的武器。
text.progress: 你把我要的材料带来了吗，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$C。真是把杰作之剑……它的平衡感非常完美。$B$B拿着你的武器，$N。带着无比的自信使用它并消灭我们的敌人吧!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Warden Haro at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

english.title: Gavel of Infinite Wisdom
english.objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2  Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus.  You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
english.description: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.$B$BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces.  Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
english.progress: Did you bring me the components I require, $n?
english.completion: You've done well, $c.  This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect. Take your weapon, $n.  Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!
english.completed: Return to Warden Haro at Hive'Ashi in Silithus.

text.title: 水歌长者
text.completion: 天堂，在他们数不尽的星星中有着世间神秘事物的答案，$N。强大，有智慧，幸运的人，能够抬头盯着天空找到答案?$B$B

english.title: Riversong the Elder
english.completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N.  Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

text.title: 金矛长者

english.completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N.  Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

text.completion: 天堂，在他们数不尽的星星中有着世间神秘事物的答案，$N。强大，有智慧，幸运的人，能够抬头盯着天空找到答案?$B$B

text.title: 好消息和坏消息
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯的纳瑞安要你给他带去20块奥金锭、10块源质矿石、10颗艾泽拉斯钻石，以及10颗蓝宝石。
text.description: 好吧，这比预期的时间稍微长了一些。现在让我看看账本上都写了些什么。$B$B<纳瑞安默默地读着账本，有的时候还喃喃自语。>$B$B好消息是，我可以99%地肯定，我能为你制作一个奥金鱼漂。当然，还有一个坏消息。$B$B坏消息就是，我需要大量的奥金，源质矿石，还有一些珍贵的宝石。$B$B把它们带来，然后我就可以开工了。
text.progress: 奥金浮标不会自已制造，$N。还有，你不要指望可以在我这里赊账。
text.completion: 就这麽说定了。我当然希望你知道自己在做什麽，$N。要钓如此大量的鱼是件很麻烦的事。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

english.title: The Good News and The Bad News
english.objectives: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.
english.description: Well that took a little longer than expected. Now let me see what this ledger says.$B$B<Narain silently reads the ledger, periodically mumbling under his breath.>$B$B The good news is that I am 99% certain that I am capable of creating an arcanite buoy that will function to your specifications. This is, of course, wholly dependant on the bad news.$B$BThe bad news is that I'm going to need a lot of arcanite, elementium ore, and rare gemstones.$B$BBring me what I need and I will craft the buoy.
english.progress: Arcanite buoys don't just make themselves, $n. And NO, you cannot borrow some money.
english.completion: A deal is a deal. I sure hope you know what you are getting yourself into, $n. This is an awful lot of trouble to go through to do some fishing.
english.completed: Return to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

text.title: 奈普图洛斯的愤怒
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉风暴海湾一带的大漩涡使用奥金浮标。
text.description: 我和你说过坏消息了吗?它的名字叫巨齿鲨:100尺长，死亡和毁灭的化身。我想我忘记和你说这个了。$B$B根据我的超级精准千里眼提供的讯息，你会在艾萨拉的海岸找到最合适使用这个浮标的地方，就在风暴海湾。$B$B你要寻找一个大漩涡，就是附近都是沉船的地方。$B$B另外，我希望你带上你的朋友。$B$B如果你成功的话，那么把权杖碎片带给安纳克罗斯。
text.progress: 时间在不断流逝，勇士。
text.completion: 干得好，$N。我将马上重新制作流沙权杖。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

english.title: The Wrath of Neptulon
english.objectives: Use the Arcanite Buoy at the Swirling Maelstrom at the Bay of Storms in Azshara.
english.description: Did I mention the bad news yet? Its name is Maws: 100 feet of death and destruction. I guess I may have forgotten that little tidbit.$B$BAccording to my superior psycho-psionic clairvoyance, you'll find that the best spot to cast this buoy is off the coast of Azshara, in the Bay of Storms.$B$BLook for a swirling maelstrom, most likely cluttered with wreckage.$B$BBy the by, I hope you have friends.$B$BNow if you somehow miraculously succeed, take the scepter shard to Anachronos.
english.progress: Time is running out, champion.
english.completion: Well done, $n. I will be able to reform the Scepter of the Shifting Sands soon.
english.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

text.title: 奈法里奥斯的腐蚀
text.objectives: 干掉奈法利安并拿到Red Scepter Shard。把Red Scepter Shard带给塔纳利斯时光之穴门口的阿纳克洛斯。你必须在5小时之内完成这个任务。
text.description: 勇士，是你吗？我受命保管这个碎片已经一千年了，在我最黑暗的时候，应该有人站出来替我把它拿回来……但是一切都是任重道远的。$B$B<瓦拉斯塔兹轻轻地咳嗽着。>$B$B耐……耐法里奥斯现在掌握着scepter shard。$B$B时间是最关键的。耐法里奥斯将要摧毁这个scepter。你必须赶快！
text.progress: 又有一位英雄因为挑战死亡之翼的子嗣而阵亡了。我们将因这样的损失而被永远诅咒……
text.completion: 瓦拉斯塔兹的灵魂终於平静了，勇士。所有的守护巨龙都在关注着你的进展。他们知道你的身边有强大的盟友。$B$B我奉命送给你一些东西，希望它可以在这场战斗中帮助你。好好使用它……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

english.title: Nefarius's Corruption
english.objectives: Slay Nefarian and recover the Red Scepter Shard. Return the Red Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. You have 5 hours to complete this task.
english.description: Champion, is it you? A thousand years it has been since I was entrusted the shard and it is at my darkest hour that one should rise to relieve me of it... But what would tragedy be without cruelty?$B$B<Vaelastrasz coughs weakly.>$B$BNe... Nefarius now holds the scepter shard.$B$BTime is of the essence. Nefarius plans to destroy the shard. You must hurry!
english.progress: Another of our heroes lost to the spawn of Deathwing. We will be cursed with this suffering forever...
english.completion: Vaelastrasz's soul is at ease, champion. The Aspects all watch your progress with great interest. Know that you have powerful allies. I was commanded to grant you something to aid you in this struggle. Use it well...
english.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

text.title: 战地任务
text.objectives: 向雷戈虫巢外的奥格瑞玛军团报到，从克鲁格·碎颅那里拿到签过字的战地任务文件，把它交给希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者卡尔东。$B$B注意：给奥格瑞玛军团的士兵治疗或者施放增益法术会打开你的PvP标志。
text.description: 你好，$N。在我为你布置更重要的任务之前，你需要首先完成一些常规的战地任务。$B$B你可以在佐拉虫穴外找到克鲁格·碎颅的部队。$B$B向他报到，然后拿着你完成任务的证明文件回到我这里来。那时我将会给你下达进一步的指令。$B$B哦，别忘了离铁炉堡军团远一些。由于联盟和部落的志愿兵之间摩擦不断，我们被迫把他们分开来。
text.progress: 你已完成你的战地任务了吗，$N?你可以在雷戈虫巢外面找到劈颅队长。
text.completion: 看的出来克鲁格不常使用文书工作。他用异种的鲜血签署这份文件!$B$B很好，$N。我安排了一连串适合$C技能的任务给你。$B$B有你和像你一样的人继续努力，我们的敌人很快就会被击垮!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Field Duty
english.objectives: Report to Krug Skullsplit at the Orgrimmar Legion post in front of Hive'Regal.  Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers, obtain Signed Field Duty Papers and bring them to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold.$B$BNote: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Orgrimmar Legion will flag you for PvP.
english.description: Greetings, $N.  Before I assign you to more involved tasks in the war, you'll need to do your share of field duty.  $B$BYou will find Captain Skullsplit's Orgrimmar Legion outside Hive'Regal.$B$BReport to him and come back to me with proof of your field service.  I shall have a more advanced assignment ready for you.$B$BOh, please do your best to stay away from the Ironforge Brigade.  Tensions are high among our Alliance and Horde volunteers.
english.progress: You've completed your field duty, $n?  Captain Skullsplit can be found outside of Hive'Regal.
english.completion: I can tell that Krug has little use for paperwork.  He signed this in silithid blood! Very well, $n.  I've prepared a set of tasks that should make good use of your skills as a $c. With the continued efforts of you and people like you, our enemy will soon be crushed!
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 战地任务文件
text.progress: 战地任务报告?这是什麽狗屁规矩啊，$N?
text.completion: 若在古老时代，我会用生物的血在你前额注记你的功劳。索尔坚持我们要服从德鲁伊的命令。$B$B把这些文件拿回到塞纳里奥城堡。我确信他们有适合的工作要交付於你。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Krug Skullsplit in Silithus.

english.title: Field Duty Papers
english.completion: In the old days I would've marked your forehead with the creature's blood to mark your accomplishment here.  Thrall insists we comply with the Druids' requests. Here, take these papers and go back to Cenarion Hold.  I'm sure they will have suitable work for you.
english.completed: Return to Krug Skullsplit in Silithus.

text.title: 伊兰尼库斯，梦境之暴君
text.objectives: 到达纳苏斯的城墙外去找到玛法里奥的亲信。
text.description: 这将是一段救赎之旅，英雄。如果今天我要死去，那么我也要为了一个正义而伟大的事业而牺牲。你必须找到绿色节杖碎片，你必须净化被上古之神控制的伊兰尼库斯。$B$B到达纳苏斯去，在城墙外，你可以找到我的人。这个人将会为我们进行协调，并在不让鹿盔发现的情况下将我们的计划通知给泰兰德。$B$B<玛法里奥叹了口气。>$B$B一千年的守护终究堕落了……
text.completion: 幽光沉默着，除了有时会发出一些低沉的哼声。真古怪，它可以藉由思想与你沟通。$B$B

english.title: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream
english.objectives: Travel to the continent of Teldrassil and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of Darnassus.$B$B
english.description: This is a journey of redemption, hero. Would it be that I was slain today, I would have died for a just and righteous cause. You must recover the green scepter shard. You must cleanse Eranikus of the taint placed upon him by the Old Gods.$B$BTravel to Darnassus. Just outside the city walls you will find one of my agents. This agent will set things in motion for us and inform Tyrande of our plans without alerting Staghelm.$B$B<Malfurion sighs.>$B$BA fall from grace a thousand years in the making...
english.completion: The wisp is silent except for a low humming sound. Oddly enough, it is able to communicate with you through thoughts.

text.title: 泰兰德和雷姆洛斯
text.objectives: 到月光林地去，和守护者雷姆洛斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我们会通知泰兰德的，凡人。玛法里奥·怒风已经让我做好应付这次事件的准备了。$B$B现在你必须去月光林地，和雷姆洛斯谈一谈。他会进一步指引你召唤伊兰尼库斯。$B$B祝你好运。
text.completion: 如果伊兰尼库斯拒绝的话，那麽我们永远无法将他唤醒。然而，他的企图却让他进入我们的世界。他想要摧毁玛法里恩的肉身。如果成功的话，那麽意味着翡翠梦境一个最强大的盟友的终结。如果玛法里恩倒下了，那麽梦魇将会吞噬整个世界……$B$B

english.title: Tyrande and Remulos
english.objectives: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.
english.description: Tyrande will be notifed, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.$B$BNow you must venture to the Moonglade and speak with Remulos. He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.$B$BWe all wish you great luck.
english.completion: It would be impossible to pull Eranikus from the Dream should he refuse. His intentions, however, require him to enter our world. He seeks to destroy the living manifestation of Malfurion. To do this successfully would mean an end to one of the most powerful allies of the Dream. The Nightmare would wholly consume all that would remain should Malfurion fall...

text.title: 腐蚀梦魇
text.objectives: 到艾泽拉斯世界的四个翡翠梦境入口去，分别收集该处的腐蚀梦魇的碎片。当你任务完成之后，就回到月光林地的守护者雷姆洛斯那里。
text.description: 你必须到艾泽拉斯世界的四个翡翠梦境入口去。在每个入口处，你都可以收集到腐蚀梦魇的碎片。住在这些地区的龙类生物身上会携带着这样的碎片。当你收集到全部四块碎片后就回到我这里来。
text.progress: (雷姆洛斯陷入沉思。)
text.completion: 你准备好了吗?我们即将乞求庇护的世界准备好了吗?我不知道…我对玛法里恩有一定的职责，职责与荣耀…$B$B
text.completed: Return to Keeper Remulos at Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.

english.title: The Nightmare's Corruption
english.objectives: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each. Return to Keeper Remulos in the Moonglade when you have completed this task.$B$B
english.description: You must travel to the four dream portals of Azeroth. From each you must draw a fragment of the Nightmare's corruption. The dragonkin that inhabit these areas will hold such fragments. Return to me when you have gathered these fragments.
english.completion: Are you prepared? Is the world prepared for what we are about to invoke? I do not know... I am bound by duty to Malfurion. Duty and honor...
english.completed: Return to Keeper Remulos at Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.

text.title: 噩梦显现
text.objectives: 保护永夜港免受伊兰尼库斯的伤害。不要让守护者雷姆洛斯死亡。不要杀掉伊兰尼库斯。保护好你们自己。等待泰兰妲。
text.description: 我们必须尽量控制伊兰尼库斯，我们要让他获得救赎，而不是摧毁他。$B$B泰兰妲已经在赶来帮助我们的路上了。我们必须守住巨龙的攻击，保护永夜港免遭伤害。$B$B做好准备!你和你的盟友是我们唯一的希望。
text.completion: 他已经获得了救赎，$N。他现在回到梦境中去纠正他所犯下的错误了。伊兰尼库斯对于玛法里恩和我的父亲来说是很强大的盟友。$B$B这些装备是给你的，$N，这是伊瑟拉亲手交给我的。你将在和异种虫群的战斗中用到它们。
text.completed: Return to Keeper Remulos at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade.

english.title: The Nightmare Manifests
english.objectives: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.$B$B
english.description: We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.$B$BTyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.$B$BBe on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.$B$B
english.completion: He is redeemed, $n. He now returns to the Dream to right what he alone has done wrong. Eranikus will be a powerful ally to Malfurion and my father. These armaments are for you, $n; given to me by Ysera herself. You would do well to make use of them in your battles against the Qiraji.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Remulos at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade.

text.title: 碧蓝圣殿骑士
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀灰烬公爵，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那个被称作灰烬公爵的元素领主将要策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他引诱出来，然后击杀他。
text.progress: 你的任务完成了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。这是你的下一个任务。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Azure Templar
english.objectives: Summon and slay an Azure Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus.  With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.$B$BFind a way to summon and destroy an Azure Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
english.progress: Is your task done yet, $n?
english.completion: Good job, $n.  Here's your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 雷戈虫巢侦查报告
text.objectives: 在雷戈虫巢内找到塞纳里奥斥候兰迪奥，然后把雷戈虫巢侦查报告交给塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角。你还必须随身带着战术任务简报 VII才能完成这个任务。
text.description: 我们派出了最好的斥候深入异种虫类的巢穴收集情报。兰迪奥这几天来一直在监视佐拉虫巢，去找到他，拿回他的书面报告。我们需要这些情报来制定战术，要尽快，$N。
text.progress: 到雷戈虫巢去找斥候兰迪奥，快一点，$N!时间紧迫!
text.completion: 你的努力获得很大的赞赏，$N。我要立刻察看这些侦察报告，去接你的下一个任务吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Hive'Regal Scout Report
english.objectives: Contact Cenarion Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal and return the Hive'Regal Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
english.description: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence.  Scout Landion has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Regal for several days now.  Find him and obtain a written report.  We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, $N.
english.progress: You'll find Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal.  Hurry, $n!  Time is of the essence.
english.completion: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, $n.  I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 亚什虫巢侦查报告
text.objectives: 设法召唤并击杀灰烬公爵，然后向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角复命。
text.description: 暮光之锤和深渊议会之间的联系看来比我们想象的还要意义重大。$B$B根据可靠情报，那个被称作灰烬公爵的元素领主将要策动暮光之锤对塞纳里奥要塞实施一次大规模的攻击。设法把他引诱出来，然后击杀他。
text.progress: 到亚什虫巢去找到斥候佳莉亚，快一点，$N!时间紧迫!
text.completion: 你的努力获得很大的赞赏，$N。我要立刻察看这些侦察报告，去接你的下一个任务吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Hive'Ashi Scout Report
english.objectives: Contact Cenarion Scout Jalia inside Hive'Ashi and return the Hive'Ashi Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
english.description: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence.  Scout Jalia has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Ashi for several days now.  Find her and obtain a written report.  We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, $N.
english.progress: You'll find Scout Jalia inside Hive'Ashi.  Hurry, $n!  Time is of the essence.
english.completion: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, $n.  I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 圣殿骑士
text.objectives: 干掉Twilight Marauder Morna和5个Twilight Marauders。当任务完成之后向唤风者梅恩·长角报告。
text.description: 许多幕光之锤的骑兵教徒经常在我们塞纳里奥要塞守卫范围之外的区域游荡，并伺机袭击我们巡逻和商旅小队。$B$B找到并击败twilight marauders和他们的领袖，一个叫做Morna的恐怖战士。当任务完成之后向唤风者梅恩·长角报告。
text.progress: 你的任务完成了吗，$N?
text.completion: 做的好，$N。暮光掠夺者曾经让我们的巡逻队吃尽了苦头，造成伤亡无数。这是你的下一个任务。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Twilight Marauders
english.objectives: Slay Twilight Marauder Morna and 2 Twilight Marauders.  Report to Windcaller Proudhorn when your task is finished.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
english.description: Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans.$B$BFind and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna.  Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.
english.progress: Is your task done yet, $N?
english.completion: Well done, $N.  The twilight marauders were inflicting an unacceptable number of casualties on our patrols.  Here's your next assignment.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 勇士回来了
text.objectives: 将绿色的权杖裂片带到塔纳利斯给时光之穴的安纳克罗斯。
text.description: 看守者等待你的归来，魔兽资料库网友。将绿色的权杖裂片带给时光之穴的安纳克罗斯。
text.completion: 大家都会知道你的行为，勇士。他们会从奥格玛开始传唱你的功绩一直到遥远的南海去。所有人都会知道青铜龙军团有这么一位勇士，$N。

english.title: The Champion Returns
english.objectives: Take the Green Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.$B$B
english.description: The keeper awaits your return, $N. Take the green scepter shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.$B$B
english.completion: Your deeds will be known to all, champion. They will sing your praises from Orgrimmar to the far reaches of the South Seas. All will know of the champion of the Bronze Flight, $n.

text.title: 卡林多的力量
text.description: 一千年过去了，正如命中注定的那样，一位勇士站在了我的面前。这位勇士将会带领他的人民走向新的纪元。$B$B上古之神在颤抖，$N。是的，它在你坚定的信念面前恐惧地颤抖着。打破克苏恩的预言吧。$B$B它知道你会到来的，勇士―它还知道卡林多的力量与你同在。当你做好准备之后，请通知我，我将把流沙权杖赐予你。
text.completion: 一千年过去了，正如命中注定的那样，一位勇士站在了我的面前。这位勇士将会带领他的人民走向新的纪元。$B$B上古之神在颤抖，$N。是的，它在你坚定的信念面前恐惧地颤抖着。打破克苏恩的预言吧。$B$B它知道你会到来的，勇士―它还知道卡林多的力量与你同在。当你做好准备之后，请通知我，我将把流沙权杖赐予你。

english.title: The Might of Kalimdor
english.completion: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $n. It must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds the next age of your people./n/nYou must wait for the armies of the Horde and the Alliance to arrive in Silithus before you may ring the Scarab Gong.

text.title: 敲响甲虫之锣!
text.progress: 甲虫之锣嗡嗡作响，给你一种不安的感觉。坚强起来，$N。一旦甲虫之锣被敲响，安其拉的大门就将被打开。$B$B从这扇大门之后涌出来的将会是混乱和毁灭。保护你的人民!
text.completion: 在甲虫之锣的下方悬挂着一颗特别的水晶，也许是龙类所留下的?
text.completed: Return to The Scarab Gong in Silithus.

english.title: Bang a Gong!
english.completion: From the ground near the gong springs a special crystal. Perhaps favor from the Brood.
english.completed: Return to The Scarab Gong in Silithus.

text.title: 精心包裹的礼物
text.completion: 这个礼物上的标签写着:$B$B给$N，$B$B祝你的冬幕节充满快乐及喜悦!$B$B

text.title: 驯鹿梅森
text.objectives: 找到驯鹿梅森。在你手头上的便笺中查找有关梅森下落的线索。$B$B当你找到它之后，往它身上洒一些驯鹿之尘，这样就可以让它摆脱任何束缚。$B$B解救梅森之后，把驯鹿之尘还给奥格瑞玛的凯玛德·考伯宾奇。
text.description: 出大事啦！驯鹿梅森被绑架了！$B$B冬天爷爷有八头驯鹿，梅森是其中的一头，也是烟林牧场的财产。我们收到了宣称对此次绑架事件负责的组织寄来的勒索信，而且不是一封，是两封！两封，你明白吗？节日即将来临，我们早已经穷得叮当响啦！帮帮忙吧，帮我们找到梅森，把它救回来！$B$B你可以看看这些勒索信里面有什么线索，找到梅森之后，把驯鹿之尘洒在它身上，这样就可以让它摆脱一切束缚！$B$B事不宜迟！
text.progress: $N!你找到牠了吗?我给你的背包中的纸条，有给你足够的讯息来确定梅特森的位置吗?我简直不敢去想那些恶棍会对梅特森做些什麽……但我们绝对不会对这样的绑架勒索行为妥协!
text.completion: 你办到了!万岁!$B$B梅特森已经飞回去冬天爷爷的兽栏里了－－是的，梅特森是会飞的－－就在不久之前!这个尘土有点像是个符咒;我知道它可以的。你拯救了冬幕节还有燻木牧场免於疾病的侵袭。谢谢你，$N。$B$B听着……因为你对这里的贡献，我希望你可以拿着这个。这是一个非常特别的东西;如果你有坐骑的话，我想你可以好好的试试它。冬幕节快乐!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar.
text.objective1: 寻找麋鹿梅特森并且解救它

english.title: Metzen the Reindeer
english.objectives: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar once Metzen is freed.
english.description: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!
english.progress: $n!  Did you find him?  Were the notes in the satchel I gave you enough information to locate Metzen?  I hate to think of what those cruel thugs might do to him... but there's no way we can afford to pay such an exorbitant ransom!
english.completion: You did it!  Huzzah! Metzen flew back into Great-father Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago!  The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would.  You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster.  Thank you, $n. Listen... because of what you've done here, I want you to have this.  It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it.  Happy Winter Veil!
english.completed: Return to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar.
english.objective1: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

text.title: 保护者之路
text.progress: 你的兴起是所有人之中最出色的，$N。愿你永远不会在保卫者之路上迷失!$B$B
text.completion: 你的兴起是所有人之中最出色的，$N。愿你永远不会在保卫者之路上迷失!$B$B

english.title: The Path of the Protector
english.completion: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted. The signet ring of the defender will offer superior protection against the forces of evil. Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.

text.title: 保护者之路
text.progress: 如此巨大的奉献真是少有。你已证明了你的意志坚定，$N。你会因为勇敢的守护着我们的世界而获得重赏。$B$B将你的徽记之戒交给我，这样我才能强化它的附魔。
text.completion: 相当出色，小家伙。你吃了不少苦才获得青铜龙军团的青睐。你的奉献已被记录下来。$B$B防卫者的徽记之戒将会在你对抗邪恶力量时提供更多的保护。$B$B提高警觉，一旦你选择了你的道路，就无法回头了。
text.completed: Return to Anachronos in Tanaris.
